jobs.title: K-8 After-School Program Coordinator (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with youth and being part of a diverse, supportive, and talented community? Are you passionate about youth program development and are a natural leader? If so, please consider joining our team at Tessellations. We are currently accepting applications for a part-time K-8 After-School Program Coordinator starting immediately. Full-time summer Camp employment opportunities are available following the school year. Competitive salary available.

Tessellations is a modern, innovative Preschool-8th non-profit school for gifted learners based in Cupertino, CA. Our mission is to provide challenging experiential education that recognizes and nurtures the individual strengths of gifted learners, empowering them to confidently express who they are and pursue a meaningful life.

At Tessellations, community is a core value. A strong community was instrumental in launching our school during the pandemic and has facilitated our strong growth and success since then. Our team consists of passionate, qualified, and dedicated staff from diverse backgrounds and includes a nationally renowned gifted expert. We believe that it is time to open a new chapter in 21st-century gifted education by forging a model that fosters a cultural ecosystem within the school that promotes innovative thinking and intellectual risk-taking. Moving on from an antiquated model born during the Industrial Revolution, we favor transferable skills over compliance and rote memorization, and collaboration over competition. We believe that assessments should function as guidance for the depth and complexity of learning rather than for judgment or sorting.

**About Our After-School Program**

Our after-school program, Base Camp, provides program options for our wonderful TK - 8th grade students following the school day. We currently operate three programs, TK-Base Camp, Odyssey, and Clubs, until 6:00 pm Monday - Thursday and until 5:00 pm on Fridays. Our Odyssey and Club programs are open to K-8. Students participating in Odyssey are able to reset from a full day of instruction by engaging in self-directed indoor/outdoor play with peers, relaxing in the Oasis Room, completing homework, and or engaging in a teacher-led activity. Our enrichment Clubs are offered seasonally with offerings in the subject categories of social studies, sports and movement, world languages, arts and crafts, and STEM. Clubs typically meet once a week for 60 minutes to 120 minutes and are led by Base Camp Teachers, Tessellations Faculty, and local enrichment program vendors.

By working at Tessellations, you will work with students who love to learn, engaged parents/guardians who are grateful for your work, and supportive colleagues who will help bring out your personal best.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work Schedule: Mon-Thu: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM; Fri 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Design and implement age-appropriate educational, creative, and physical enrichment activities tailored to K-8 students for our day camps.
* Create and foster a safe and nurturing learning environment where all students feel seen, heard, and included.
* Co-develop and facilitate engaging, student-centered enrichment activities spanning arts, STEM, and recreation that nurture elementary curiosity while encouraging middle school autonomy.
* Maintain an active and visible leadership presence within the department during operational hours, empowering staff and decisively addressing real-time operational needs in the Director's absence.
* Serve as the heart of our program’s connection with families, making sure parents/guardians feel well-informed, deeply supported, and actively invited into their child’s after-school journey.
* Support student self-regulation by implementing restorative methods, early de-escalation strategies, and growth-mindset praise that recognizes hard work and dedication.
* Facilitate restorative conflict resolution between peers, helping students identify feelings and communicate needs.
* Work with the other Base Camp staff to supervise the students during indoor and outdoor play, snack time, and transition periods.
* Track daily student attendance and follow secure student check-in/check-out procedures with authorized parents/guardians/caregivers.
* Maintain a safe and organized environment, supervising students closely at all times.
* Serve as a versatile team member by filling in for absent staff on short notice, seamlessly adapting to different roles and shifts to maintain continuous, high-quality operations.
* Support the Program Director with the coordination and facilitation of our academic competitions.
* Attend staff meetings and actively engage with professional development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of elementary and middle school experience, preferably in an after-school or summer camp program setting.
* Minimum of 1 year working with transitional kindergarten, preschool, or kindergarten-aged children (experience in after-school or summer camp settings).
* Ability to actively observe, read, and accurately interpret youth’s verbal and non-verbal cues to meet their emotional and developmental needs in real-time.
* A genuine commitment to inclusive practices that welcome and celebrate families from all backgrounds.
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Passing a criminal background check upon job offer.
* Current CPR and First Aid certifications (or willingness to obtain upon hire).
* Curriculum development experience
* High school diploma or GED

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social-emotional teaching experience
* Experience teaching gifted learners
* Proficiency with technology (G Suite in particular)
* Familiarity with and commitment to DEIJ issues
* Experience teaching twice-exceptional learners
* Connection to nature
* Enthusiastic lifelong learner
* Openness and flexibility in designing improved learning experiences

**Compensation**

Salary: $25.00 to $36.00 per hour, depending on experience

*Bene

jobs.title: Residential Care Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**T&T House of Champions | Oakland, CA**

**Residential Care & Operations Coordinator**

**Pay:** $26.00–$28.00 per hour (reviews after 90 days)  
**Schedule:** Part-Time (20+ hours per week)  
**Work Location:** In Person

**Scheduling & Shift Requirements**

**Note:** This position does not have a fixed or permanently assigned schedule. Weekly shifts will fluctuate based on staffing coverage, resident needs, and overall program operations.

Employees **must** be flexible and available to work across the following potential 8hr shifts:

* **Day:** 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM
* **Evening:** 4:00 PM – 12:00 AM
* **Overnight:** 12:00 AM – 8:00 AM

A minimum of 20 hours per week is guaranteed, with opportunities for additional hours based on program and staffing needs. Shift assignments may vary weekly, and a consistent schedule or shift cannot be guaranteed.

**About T&T House of Champions**

T&T House of Champions is a Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (STRTP) in Oakland, California, serving male youth clients ages 12–17 who require intensive out-of-home placement and therapeutic support.

Our mission is to provide a safe, structured, and supportive environment where youth can develop life skills, address mental health challenges, strengthen social relationships, and prepare for successful transitions to family-based care or independent living.

**Position Summary**

T&T House of Champions is seeking a dependable, proactive, and experienced Residential Care & Operations Coordinator to support the daily care, supervision, and operational needs of our residential clients.

This hands-on position combines direct client care with facility operations and administrative support. The individual will work under the direction of organizational leadership to help maintain a safe, structured, therapeutic, and well-managed residential environment.

The ideal candidate is adaptable, organized, accountable, and comfortable balancing the needs of clients and daily facility operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Direct Resident Care & Supervision**

* Provide direct supervision, guidance, and support to youth clients
* Promote a safe, structured, and therapeutic living environment
* Assist youth with daily living skills, personal development, and positive decision-making
* Support emotional regulation, social development, and independent living skills
* Respond appropriately to behavioral concerns and crisis situations in accordance with program protocols

**Facility Operations & Coordination**

* Support daily facility operations and help maintain a clean, safe, and organized environment
* Assist with daily routines, household activities, supplies, inventory, and facility needs
* Provide day-to-day guidance and support to direct care staff, as assigned
* Assist with shift coordination, staff communication, and smooth transitions between shifts
* Identify and communicate operational, maintenance, and safety concerns to organizational leadership

**Documentation & Program Support**

* Maintain accurate resident progress notes, daily logs, incident reports, and required documentation
* Communicate resident observations, concerns, and progress to the treatment team
* Follow established medication procedures within applicable training and authorization requirements
* Support organizational compliance with agency policies and applicable California STRTP licensing requirements
* Develop and facilitate recreational, educational, social, and life-skills activities
* Accompany youth to appointments and community resources as assigned
* Participate in mandatory meetings, trainings, and ongoing professional development

**Minimum Qualifications & Requirements**

Candidates must meet at least one of the education and experience pathways, subject to applicable STRTP requirements:

* Must successfully complete required federal and state fingerprint-based criminal background clearances, including applicable FBI and California Department of Justice (DOJ) fingerprint checks, and meet all applicable STRTP clearance requirements
* Must be at least 21 years of age
* Must possess a valid California driver's license and maintain a driving record that meets organizational insurance and driving requirements
* Bachelor's degree or valid Child Development Teaching Permit
* At least 12 semester units in a relevant field plus 100 hours of youth experience
* Qualifying Alcohol/Drug Counselor certificate or vocational credential, with required youth experience
* At least one year of experience working or volunteering in a licensed group home or STRTP
* Other CDSS-approved education and experience combinations, where applicable

**Additional Requirements:**

* Must be willing and able to transport youth to appointments, activities, community resources, and other destinations as assigned
* Must be available to drive for other organizational business and operational needs as necessary
* Knowledge of community resources and support services
* Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team
* Ability to maintain professional boundaries, confidentiality, and sound judgment
* Flexibility to work day, evening, and overnight shifts based on program needs
* Must attend mandatory monthly trainings for ongoing education and professional development

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working with adolescents, at-risk youth, or individuals with behavioral or mental health needs
* Experience in a group home, STRTP, residential treatment, or behavioral health setting
* Previous leadership, staff coordination, or facility operations experience
* Knowledge of trauma-informed care, crisis intervention, and de-escalation techniques

Pay: $26.00 - $29.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20.0 per week

Work Location: In person

Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

High school diploma or equivalent required

40

Full time

$22.86 - $36.86

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role works across USRO and partners with Safety, Research, Product, and Engineering to build sustainable operational programs for emerging model safety risks.

**About the Role**

You’ll build and run operational programs for emerging model safety risks. You’ll work with Safety, Research, Product, Engineering, and Operations to define what a program needs to detect, when it should escalate, and how to tell if it’s working. This is a senior individual contributor role based in San Francisco.

You will create clarity around scope, decision rights, dependencies, and success measures, then lead pilots through evidence-based rollout decisions and ongoing ownership.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; work model to confirm.

*Please note: This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

* Build reporting and feedback loops that turn operational findings into actionable input for Safety, Research, and Product partners.
* Establish documentation, training, quality checks, and a sustainable plan for ongoing ownership.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**About the Team**
------------------

Our sales and success teams are the heart and soul of DoorDash, helping us partner with top merchants (think restaurants, grocers, convenience stores, retailers) across the country to grow their revenue and help them operate even better. As DoorDash grows both in scale and scope of offering, the strength of our sales engine and organizational structure must grow with it.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Manager in Sales Strategy and Operations to be the strategic and operational partner to our SMB Business Development (BD) team as it expands its remit and increases restaurant coverage. You will own the operating foundation for BD's merchant sales motion, including goal setting, pipeline management, lead allocation, and performance reporting.

* In this role, you will make sure we are Making efficient, data-driven decisions,
* Building scalable operating systems for a growing sales motion,
* Using and advocating for AI tooling, and
* Centralizing the metrics that drive sales performance. You'll work with our Sales, Selection, Operations, Product, Finance, and Analytics teams to build and scale that foundation, helping BD win new restaurant partners and grow those partnerships.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Build from first principles.** BD's sales motion is evolving to capture top restaurants in priority markets, and this role will design how it runs: goal structures, input and activity metrics, pipeline stages, and rules of engagement with adjacent sales teams. You'll question "this is how it's always been done" and build what the team needs next.
* **Drive operational excellence.** You'll set up and run reporting cadences, rigorous pipeline reviews, and productivity inspection with sales leaders, taking each one end to end from idea to execution and grounding decisions in data.
* **Own lead strategy and GTM targeting.** You'll partner with our GM teams to point BD reps at the highest-value opportunities, with clear ownership across teams.
* **Operate at 10,000 feet and 1 foot.** One day you'll size goals and model capacity for a growing team. The next you'll be in diagnosing and improving data fidelity or tracing a pacing gap to its root cause.
* **Look around corners with AI.** You'll find where AI tooling can remove manual work from sales operations and reporting, then build and scale those solutions, helping the team become more efficient as it grows.

**We're excited about you because…**
------------------------------------

* You have 6+ years of experience in sales strategy and operations, revenue operations, consulting, business development, analytics, or related fields, with a track record of leading initiatives and hitting goals
* You have experience standing up or scaling sales operating systems, such as goaling and compensation inputs, pipeline management, territory or lead allocation, and CRM workflows (Salesforce or similar)
* You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working independently with large, complex data sets, and you are skilled at modeling in Excel / Google Sheets and building dashboards in visualization tools (e.g. Sigma, Tableau)
* You are fluent with AI tools (e.g. LLMs, AI-assisted coding and automation) and have used them to automate workflows, speed up analysis, or improve data quality, with the judgment to validate outputs carefully
* You are a strong business thinker who lets data win arguments and can tell a clear story behind the numbers to audiences from frontline managers to senior leaders
* You have strong cross-functional, project management, and communication skills, and you can align multiple stakeholders around a shared plan
* You are an owner with a strong bias for action, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to roll up your sleeves and flex up or down as needed
* You have a Bachelor's degree or higher

**Why You'll Love Working at DoorDash…**
----------------------------------------

* **We are leaders** – Leadership is not limited to our management team. It's something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.
* **We are operators** – We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions to lead our company and our industry is what we do on every project, every day.
* **We are learners** – Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we've been in a role for one year or one minute. We are committed to learning and implementing what is best for our customers, merchants, and dashers.
* **We are one team** – The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

We expect this position to be filled by 01/13/27

**About DoorDash**
------------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**WHAT IS BOX?**

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Box is building for the next wave of AI-native companies and wants to make Box the platform they know, trust, and build on. This role will help expand Box's presence in the AI ecosystem by identifying high-growth partners, shaping technical partnerships, and helping external builders understand how to build with Box in the right way. You'll help ensure the most prominent AI companies know Box, integrate with Box, and grow with Box as part of their product strategy.

**WHY BOX NEEDS YOU**

We are at the beginning of a period of incredible transformation in the way organizations find and engage talent. AI has the ability to super-charge the productivity and effectiveness of recruiting teams and yet it's never been more important to ensure that Recruiters have the time to build deep and authentic connections with their candidates. To stand out from the noise and provide candidates with an exceptional, white-gloved experience, the process needs to feel seamless. 'Surprise and delight' is the goal. To help us make that a reality, the Box Talent Team is hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to help us support and enhance our scalable, data-driven, candidate-friendly recruiting processes. You'll be a hands-on partner across the Talent Operations team, covering process, systems, data, and programs. You'll also provide dedicated operational support to our internal Executive Recruiting function.

This role suits someone with immense curiosity, someone constantly thinking of ways to make things better, who enjoys making the complex simple, and who is excited to use AI to make recruiters more effective and hiring managers more confident in making critical hiring decisions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Core recruiting operations

* Manage day-to-day recruiting operations across the full hiring lifecycle: requisition intake and approvals, interview scheduling and coordination, offers, and onboarding handoff.
* Administer and optimize our systems such as Thrive (Executive Recruiting CRM), ATS (Greenhouse) and surrounding tools, including configuration, workflows, user access, and data hygiene.
* Serve as a point of escalation for recruiters, coordinators, and hiring managers on process and system questions.
* Document processes, create playbooks and training materials, and drive consistent adoption of best practices.

Executive recruiting operations

* Partner with the executive recruiting team to support confidential, high-touch searches, including pipeline tracking, process management, and coordination with executives and external partners.
* Maintain trackers, reporting, and process documentation for executive searches, and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Help deliver a polished, consistent candidate and stakeholder experience for senior-level hiring.

Data, reporting, and insights

* Build and maintain recruiting dashboards and reports on pipeline health, time-to-fill, source effectiveness, and recruiter and interviewer load.
* Run recurring reporting for the TA team and business partners, and turn data into clear takeaways.
* Support data integrity and audit readiness across systems.

Automation, AI, and process innovation

* Find manual or repetitive work across the recruiting lifecycle, then design and build solutions using workflow automation, integrations, scripting, and AI tools.
* Pilot and implement AI-enabled use cases, such as drafting, summarization, data enrichment, and reporting, with attention to security, privacy, and responsible use.
* Work with IT, People Systems, and other cross-functional partners on integrations and system improvements.
* Test new tools and features, gather feedback, and help roll out changes.

Programs and projects

* Own or contribute to recruiting operations projects, such as process rollouts, system migrations, and seasonal or campus programs, from planning through launch.
* Support vendor relationships and tool evaluations as needed.

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills and a service mindset when working with recruiters, hiring managers, executives, and candidates.

jobs.description:
**Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.**

**About Trial Library**

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

### **About the Role**

Reporting to the Head of Payer Strategy, the Associate Project Manager will support Trial Library’s payer and employer partnerships and make sure partners have a smooth experience from launch onward. This is a hands-on, client-facing role that requires cross-functional collaboration. You will be the day-to-day point of contact for active health plan and employer partners and keep every partner informed, supported, and engaged.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the main day-to-day contact for active health plan and employer partners: keep regular communication going, share updates, and gather feedback.
* Lead implementation and launch of new partnerships, including eligibility file setup, referral pathways, member communication plans, and integration with existing care management or benefits programs.
* Own all partner inquiries and troubleshooting, resolving issues quickly.
* Work cross functionally with the operations, provider partnerships team, and products team leading efforts to ensure all client deliverables are executed on time and with superior quality in mind.
* Deliver timely, accurate reports to partners on Trial Library’s performance, including member outreach, engagement, navigation, trial matching, and enrollment outcomes.
* Help the Head of Payer Strategy develop value and ROI reporting that shows the clinical and economic impact of partnerships.
* Prepare and lead partner presentations, from program launch to quarterly business reviews and renewal conversations.
* Oversee all partner-facing materials, including member communications, benefit collateral, co-branded outreach, and performance documentation.
* Track account health and flag chances to expand or renew to the Head of Payer Strategy.
* Help build scalable processes for partner onboarding, reporting, and account management.
* Make sure partner communications and data handling follow HIPAA and contract requirements.
* Stay current on Trial Library’s product offering and value for health plans, employers, and their members.

### **Your Requirements:**

* 3–5 years of experience in health plan operations, employer benefits, care management, healthcare account management, or customer success.
* Experience with payer or employer reporting needs, such as engagement and utilization metrics, outcomes, and value or ROI reporting.
* Familiarity with health plan operations, employer-sponsored benefits, or population health programs.
* Working knowledge of HIPAA and handling protected health information (PHI).
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners at once.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high level of professionalism with internal and external stakeholders.
* An analytical approach, comfortable using data to drive action and tell a clear story.
* A bias toward action, stepping in before issues arise.
* Able to work autonomously.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, early-stage startup.

### **Nice to Have:**

* Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or a high-growth startup.
* Familiarity with oncology, clinical trials, precision medicine, or patient navigation.
* Experience supporting value-based care programs or payer partnerships.
* Experience with CRM and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Tableau, Looker).

### **Compensation & On-Site Requirement**

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. The salary range for this position is $108,000–$135,000 per year and reflects a good faith estimate of base pay for candidates working in this location. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

### **Why Trial Library**

* Meaningful impact — helping patients access clinical trials faster through better technology and workflows
* High ownership environment — autonomy to build, test, and influence strategy across the business
* Collaborative team culture — low ego, high trust, and close partnership across functions
* Opportunity for growth — join at an early stage with meaningful exposure to company-building and decision-making

### **Our Core Values**

* Ally is our favorite moniker
* The broadest reach is worth the effort
* Celebrate measurable improvements in access and outcomes
* Fearless advocates for representation in research
* Incentives matter to stakeholders choosing our products
* Taking initiative is actually giving
* We are accountable for the experience of patients and providers
* Empathy and humility are the real dynamic duo

* Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents, along with disability, life, and supplemental insurance options designed to support your overall well-being.
* Time Off & Workplace Support: Flexible paid time off, observed company holidays, and a one-time home office stipend to help you create a productive and comfortable remote workspace within our hybrid environment.

jobs.title: Project Manager/Foreman
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:** Established in California in 2013, Green Water and Power has rapidly grown to operate in over 35 states, positioning itself as a leader in the sustainable energy sector. Named the #1 electric vehicle (EV) installer in America, we take pride in having deployed more than 15,000 EV chargers and completed approximately 5 megawatts (MW) of solar energy projects.

As an EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) certified turnkey engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) firm, we leverage our in-house expertise to efficiently manage and execute large-scale projects. Our dedication to sustainability and quality extends beyond project completion; we also provide comprehensive operation and maintenance services to ensure optimal performance for the projects we develop, as well as for third-party installations.

**Position Overview:** Green Water and Power is seeking an experienced Project Manager/Foreman to own commercial EV charging projects while leading installation work directly on site. This role combines the hands-on technical leadership of a Foreman with the planning, and client communication of a Project Manager. You will supervise an installation crew, manage project schedules and coordinate with engineering, procurement, and local authorities, and serve as the customer’s primary point of contact. Your leadership will be crucial in delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality installations on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage commercial EV charging projects for the entirety of the project.
* Review plan designs and single-line diagrams with the engineering department; build project schedules and crew plans for each site.
* Coordinate with procurement and supply chain teams to ensure timely availability and delivery of chargers, materials, and equipment.
* Obtain and finalize permits; arrange for and conduct inspections with local AHJs and coordinate utility requirements as needed.
* Schedule and lead preconstruction site walks and postconstruction site inspections.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients: coordinate start times and project schedules, provide regular updates, and resolve concerns promptly.
* Lead and supervise electrical installations for commercial EV charging systems (AC and DC), working alongside crews in the field.
* Ensure compliance with NEC, OSHA, and other safety and electrical standards.
* NEC Compliance: Strong knowledge of Article 625 and other relevant NEC standards for EV charging installations.
* Wiring and Terminations: Experience with 240V/208V circuits, wiring EVSE units to panels, and using torque tools per spec.
* Conduit and Raceway Work: Skilled in EMT and PVC conduit installation; able to bend, mount, and seal per job specs.
* Grounding and Bonding: Capable of installing compliant grounding systems for EVSE units and subpanels.
* Testing and Commissioning: Use of electrical testing tools (multimeter, insulation resistance testers, etc.) for system validation and diagnostics.
* Conduct site visits to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to keep projects on track.
* Lead and mentor Junior and Senior Level EV Installers, providing guidance, technical support, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of safety within the installation teams, ensuring strict adherence to safety protocols, procedures, and best practices.
* Document punch list items, photo document progress, and submit daily status and job closeout reports to management, ensuring projects are on time and on budget.
* Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of project details, installations, maintenance activities, and repairs.
* Accountable for tools, equipment, and company vehicles, ensuring all are in good working order and that project sites are properly cleaned up.
* Must be responsive to emails and phone calls from clients, crews, and management.

**Qualifications:**

* 4-6 years of experience as an Electrical Foreman or Lead Installer, preferably in EV infrastructure or renewable energy.
* 2+ years of project management experience on commercial electrical or construction projects, including scheduling and budget tracking.
* DIR Licensed Journeyman or Master Electrician (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of the NEC, including Articles 625 and 690.
* Ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and single-line diagrams.
* EVITP Certification or the ability to obtain one.
* An OSHA 30 certification or the ability to obtain one.
* Proven experience with EV charger deployment and solar panel and canopy installations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project scheduling tools.
* Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational abilities.

**General Requirements:**

* Valid driver's license, clean driving record, and access to reliable transportation.
* Physical ability to lift and maneuver heavy equipment (up to 50 lbs.).
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* High attention to detail and safety.
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once and prioritize deadlines.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in field and office environments.
* Comfortable working outdoors, at heights, and in varying weather conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required.
* Travel is required.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on experience (DOE), up to $50 per hour.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package.
* Retirement Savings Plan
* Paid time off and paid holidays
* Career advancement opportunities.

**Additional Information:**

* Criminal background check, pre-employment drug screen.
* This position requires travel to different job sites. Overnight stays may be necessary depending on the project location.
* Overtime and weekend work may be necessary to meet project deadlines.

**About Degryse Electric**

Degryse Electric, Inc. is an established commercial electrical contractor specializing in electrical installations for medical facilities, retail spaces, office buildings, and other commercial environments. We take pride in delivering quality workmanship, maintaining strong client relationships, and providing a supportive, team-oriented work environment.

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Project Manager / Estimator to oversee commercial electrical projects from initial estimating and bidding through construction and final closeout.

**Key Responsibilities**

Electrical Estimating & Preconstruction

* Manage project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, change orders, contracts, and closeout documents.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in commercial electrical project management and estimating, including design-build projects.
* Strong knowledge of commercial electrical systems, materials, installation methods, and construction processes.
* Experience preparing electrical estimates, reviewing blueprints, and performing material and labor takeoffs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets, schedules, subcontractors, and field operations.
* Proficiency with electrical estimating and project management software.
* Strong understanding of electrical codes, construction safety, and industry standards.
* Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel to local project sites.

* Career advancement opportunities

Part-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes | East Bay, CA**

**$28-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience, and our company's infrastructure.

This is a part-time position to start, with approximately **10-12 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners and our office manager to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day-to-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the team at large.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners. You will be involved with design and sales meetings as needed, but this is not the primary function of your role.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients for their projects. This will be during active construction, as well as pre-construction.

* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication

You will **not** be responsible for estimating, setting project pricing, budgeting, payroll, or making company financial decisions.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is **extremely dependable, organized, communicative, and thoughtful**. You don't need to be a landscape architect or designer, but you do need to understand landscape construction and have a genuine interest in how things are built.

The right person will:

* Have exceptionally strong communication skills
* Be comfortable and confident working directly with clients

* Have a high standard for craftsmanship and attention to detail

We are a **small, high-end boutique landscape design and installation company**, and our clients expect a thoughtful, professional, highly communicative experience. We are looking for someone who naturally understands that standard and can help us maintain it as the company grows.

**Growth & Training**

This position will begin with approximately **10-15 hours per week**, with the potential to grow to twice that as responsibilities increase.

Initially, you will **shadow the owners and learn how we manage projects, communicate with clients, work with our crew, and maintain our standards**. As you become familiar with our way of working, you will gradually take on more responsibility for coordinating projects and installations, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day-to-day coordination as the owners steps back from that role. You will continue to work closely alongside our on & offsite leadership, and owners as applicable.

We are looking for someone who is naturally intuitive, observant, and proactive. A good candidate is someone who notices what needs attention, anticipates problems before they become problems, and can often see the next step without having to be told. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills, take on increasing responsibility, and grow with the company over time.

**Why Work With Us**

* Demonstrated ability to motivate teams, provide day-to-day guidance and feedback, and lead others toward shared program goals.

jobs.title: Design Quality Manager
jobs.description:
Our mission is to cure cancer through high performance, accessible early cancer detection. That means saving lives.

DELFI Diagnostics is a Johns Hopkins spinoff focused on the non-invasive detection of cancer at earlier stages, when it is most curable. DELFI uses artificial intelligence and whole genome sequencing to detect unique patterns of DNA fragmentation in the blood of patients with cancer. These analyses are performed through simultaneous examination of millions of DNA sequences using machine learning to identify tumor-specific abnormalities.

In our passionate pursuit to radically improve health outcomes, we serve humanity when we:

* Lead with Science, Anchor in Pragmatism: We pioneer life-changing science by ensuring quality, transparency, and rigor at all times. We explore thoughtfully, experiment smartly, and deliver impact with conviction.
* Build With & For All: We embrace diverse backgrounds to innovate and achieve together. We are not just building a product - we aim to disrupt the path of cancer for all - no matter geography or socioeconomic class
* Put We over I: We are a home for high-performing people. Through teamwork, we build collective intelligence. Each of us wins when those we serve and those who serve with us-win. We show up with empathy, humility, and integrity at every step of the journey.

DELFI has 1-2 designated in-office working days each week for employees who live within within 50 miles of Palo Alto, CA.

### **About the Role**

In this role, you will lead and develop DELFI’s Design Quality, Risk Management, Process Validation, and Equipment Qualification programs from a Quality perspective. Own the Risk Management Plan and Report, support cross-functional working sessions to current and complete state, and ensure risk file linkage to design outputs, V&V evidence, and labeling.

* Author, revise, review, and approve standard operating procedures and other controlled documents.

### **What You'll Bring to DELFI**

We’re passionate about delivering on Our Promise to improve the lives of patients and create healthier communities for all. We foster a culture of inclusivity, integrity and creativity while boldly pursuing answers to the world’s most complex health challenges and transforming society.

As a Vendor Operations Associate within the Chief Marketing Office (CMO), you will serve as an operational backbone and strategic partner, managing end-to-end procurement, contracting, and vendor enablement. **JOIN A TEAM THAT CARES ABOUT THE PLANET—AND EACH OTHER**

At Eocene Environmental Group, Inc., our mission is to protect people, power, and the planet. We believe that meaningful work starts with meaningful values—integrity, innovation, safety, and stewardship. jobs.title: Partner Support Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

The Claude Partner Network is how partners build, sell, and deliver on Claude. Partner Support keeps them moving: getting set up, getting certified, registering their work, and understanding where they stand in the program. It runs in layers. Self-serve and an AI support agent handle what they can, an outsourced vendor team works the in-scope (L1) topics, and our specialists take the escalated (L2) cases that need judgment.

As our Partner Support Operations Lead, you will run partner support end to end: the team, the operating model, and the systems behind every layer. Partner Programs sets program policy. You will build and run the service levels, knowledge, quality bar, and escalation paths that put that policy into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows.

This is a hands-on operator and builder role. You will be close enough to the queue to know why a case was hard or a rule broke, while you build the team, the vendor coverage, and the Claude-powered automation that keep support from growing in line with partner count.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Manage the partner support team: set priorities and clear expectations, coach the Partner Support Specialists, address performance early, and expand the team if volume or coverage calls for it
* Own the support operating model: the L1 and L2 boundary, severity definitions, service levels, and escalation paths; review misrouted and wrongly escalated tickets, and fix the rule as well as the ticket
* Run the L2 queue to its service levels: coverage across shifts, one owner for every case, clean handoffs to the teams that hold the answer, and careful handling of sensitive and high-impact partner issues
* Manage the support service line with our business process outsourcing (BPO) team: work with their leads day to day and hold a stated quality bar through training and sign-off for each new cohort, the QA rubric and calibration, the weekly operating review, and corrective action when quality or coverage slips
* Own the knowledge layer: one source of truth for the help center, macros, and AI agent content, updated when a program change ships, so every layer gives partners the same answer from day one of a launch
* Own the support platform: routing, conversation attributes, views, workflows, access, and service-level reporting; keep the taxonomy short, consistent, and reportable
* Scale through self-serve, vendors, and Claude: use topic and outcome data to decide what moves to each, and build automations for tagging, routing, QA screening, and reporting; test them on real tickets and add human checkpoints where a wrong answer carries risk
* Turn what partners ask into fixes: bring the recurring causes behind ticket volume to Partner Programs, Partner Business Systems, and other owners, and follow each one through until the tickets stop
* Run support on a scorecard covering responsiveness, resolution, escalation accuracy, and quality, and use it to plan capacity and to tell the team, the vendor, and leadership what to fix next

**Minimum qualifications**
--------------------------

* Support operations experience at a technology company, including managing a small team
* Experience running an outsourced or BPO support team: onboarding waves, service levels, QA rubrics, calibration, and performance feedback
* A track record of building a tiered support model from an early stage and running it as volume grew
* Hands-on depth in Intercom or a comparable platform (Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud): routing rules, attributes, workflows, reporting, and permissions
* Experience running knowledge and content for an AI support agent, including how to review answer quality and close content gaps
* Strong analytical instincts: able to read ticket data, find the cause behind a spike or a backlog, and turn it into a fix and a capacity plan
* Sound judgment while the program is still moving: able to make the call with incomplete information, hold a policy line with a frustrated partner or an internal stakeholder, and keep the relationship intact
* A builder's mindset and clear writing: you use tools like Claude to automate your own work, and you document what you build so a new teammate or vendor lead can run it

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Support operations experience in a B2B, partner, or channel environment
* Experience supporting a partner, reseller, systems integrator, or independent software vendor (ISV) program
* Experience building support coverage across regions, time zones, or languages
* Familiarity with Salesforce, and with the Claude API, Claude Code, or MCP

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$215,000 - $300,000 USD

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Ramp's Enterprise Customer Success Managers on the Lifecycle team don't stop at go-live — they make sure customers keep getting more from Ramp as their business grows. Ramp has grown its product suite significantly over the last several years. As we've matured as an organization, our customer relationships have grown more complex too: customers are buying more of the platform at once, running it across more entities and teams, and relying on it for more of how their finance function operates. Hitting an activation milestone doesn't mean the job's finished. Too often, a feature that could solve a real problem goes unused because no one is there to show how it would work in that customer's business.

That's where you come in. This is a role for people who understand how finance teams actually run, who think in years rather than quarters, and who already use AI the way surgeons use instruments: not occasionally, not as an experiment, but as the default way they work. You'll own the customer experience after implementation for a book of Ramp's highest-potential enterprise customers, partnering with Account Management on long-term account strategy. You'll also be one of the first Lifecycle CSMs on a newly formed team, helping define how Ramp earns and keeps the trust of its most important customers.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the post-implementation experience for a book of enterprise customers, with clear accountability for sustained adoption, customer satisfaction, and renewal readiness
* Drive sustained adoption by understanding each customer's goals and guiding them toward the workflows that improve outcomes for their business — including the products and features they've already purchased but haven't fully put to work
* Act as each customer's expert in finance workflows: understand how they run their business, advise on decisions as their needs change, and make the value of new Ramp capabilities clear in their context
* Build multi-threaded relationships across every account and partner with Account Management on executive relationships, so the account stays steady through change like a new Controller or CFO
* Partner with Account Management on QBRs and executive business reviews, quantifying Ramp's impact in the language CFOs and Controllers care about — close cycle improvement, spend visibility, savings, and ROI — not just product usage metrics
* Spot opportunities for growth and bring them to Account Management, who owns renewals and expansion; as customers add products, drive ongoing activation so they reach value quickly
* Run your book on data: monitor usage, CP, and risk signals, get ahead of challenges and escalations, and see them through to resolution well before renewal is on the calendar
* Use AI tools daily to prepare for customer calls, build materials, synthesize data, identify account risk, and operate at a pace traditional methods can't match
* Bring customer feedback back into Ramp — surfacing patterns, gaps, and opportunities from your accounts to shape how Ramp evolves
* Help build the motion from the ground up: executive sponsor programs, champion groups, churn reviews, and the playbooks every future Lifecycle CSM will run

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* **Long-term account ownership** — You've owned a book of customers past launch and through renewal, and you have measurable retention, adoption, or satisfaction results to show for it. Finance or fintech context is a plus but not required.
* **Customer experience mindset** — You measure success by how customers feel about working with you, not only by milestones hit. You get ahead of problems before customers raise them and own escalations through resolution.
* **Executive relationship building** — You build multi-threaded relationships across finance, operations, and the C-suite. When your champion leaves, the account doesn't leave with them.
* **Financial impact communication** — You can walk a CFO through the value Ramp has delivered, connect adoption to P&L outcomes, and help make the case for continued investment in financial terms, not product terms. A finance background is not required — fluency is.
* **AI fluency as a daily habit** — You already use AI tools habitually in your work. You use them to prep for calls, synthesize information, build customer-facing materials, and automate repetitive tasks. This is how you work, not something you're exploring. Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment.
* **Data-driven book management** — You prioritize your time based on usage, revenue, and risk signals, not on who emailed last. You can spot an at-risk account months before renewal and know what to do about it.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, AI-Native
jobs.description:
**At a glance:** San Francisco, on site, five days · $110K to $130K base, $140K to $175K on-target; senior $130K to $155K base, $170K to $205K on-target · Plus equity · License within 30 days, paid by us · No insurance background needed

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage, backed by Y Combinator, with offices in San Francisco and Atlanta. We do the insurance work end to end for about 1,000 new small businesses a month, with agents and people working the same accounts.

### **Role in one line**

Own a book of small businesses after they buy, keep them covered as they grow, and run the whole book with agents.

A small business buys a policy and keeps moving. It hires its first employee, adds a truck, wins a contract that requires workers’ comp, opens a second location. Those are triggers, and they are predictable. At most brokerages nobody notices until the renewal, or the claim. At Harper you notice first.

### **Why now**

Our most important accounts need one named owner, and today too many people touch them. Hundreds of our customers also need coverage they do not have yet, most often workers’ comp and commercial auto, and that is the cheapest growth we have. You start with about 250 accounts. Agents read every email, call, payment and document on each one, flag what changed, and draft the outreach. You decide what matters and make the call.

### **What you own**

* **One named owner per account, and it is you.** The customer knows who to call, and you close the loop.
* **Coverage that matches the business.** New vehicles, payroll, locations and contracts. Catch the gap before it becomes a problem.
* **Growth where it is real.** Workers’ comp, commercial auto and property for businesses that need them. Never coverage they do not need.
* **Accounts protected early.** Payment problems, pending cancellations and audits: you see them first and get them fixed with the right teammate.
* **Renewals started early,** with our renewals team, well before the deadline.
* **Your own automations.** The parts of the book that eat your week, you automate.

### **What done means**

* No surprise cancellations in your book.
* When a customer is thinking about leaving, you see it in the account before the notice arrives; when one leaves, the reason is on the record.
* Your book is bigger than when you started, and you did not add hours to run it.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Day 30:** you know your book, you are licensed or close, and every account has a current status and a next action.
* **Day 60:** you have automated what was eating your week, and your first expansions have closed.
* **Day 90:** no surprise cancellations, and the book has grown.

### **Who thrives here**

* You have owned a book of customers at a fintech, software or services company, with a number: retention, expansion or activation.
* You use agents and automation in your own work and can show how you handled a bigger book without more hours.
* You are direct on the phone and comfortable talking about money.
* Bonus: you have served contractors, truckers, restaurants or other small business owners.

### **What we teach, what you bring**

We teach the insurance and pay for your license. You bring book ownership, curiosity about what changed in a customer’s business, and the habit of building tools for yourself.

### **Who should not apply**

* You want the highest quota and the most variable pay. Our renewals and new business teams carry more.
* You treat a request for a certificate as a ticket rather than a conversation.
* You want to run quarterly business reviews for ten strategic accounts. This is a book of hundreds.

### **Pay, schedule and place**

* $110K to $130K base and $140K to $175K on-target, or $130K to $155K base and $170K to $205K on-target at the senior level. About a quarter of on-target pay is variable, paid quarterly on retained premium and bound expansion premium, starting when your license is issued. Plus equity.
* In the San Francisco office Monday to Friday, starting around 7:30 to 8 AM. Phone-heavy: small business owners are busy and direct, and they expect you to be the same.
* You do not remarket renewals or sell new business from scratch, and you do not process routine certificates. Those teams close; you bring them in and stay on the account.

### **Benefits**

Health, dental and vision. Breakfast, lunch and dinner at the office, commuter benefits and a gym membership. Your license is on us.

### **How we hire (usually inside two weeks)**

* A 15-minute call with a founder. We reply within 48 hours at every stage.
* A book sample: a synthetic book of 40 accounts. Find the real expansion opportunities and the accounts at risk, write the outreach for two, and take one hard call with us.
* A Super Day on site, working practice cases beside the team. We decide within 48 hours.

### **How to apply**

Send your resume and tell us about a customer you kept or grew: what you noticed first, how you noticed it, and what you built to notice it sooner next time.

*Harper is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will make it work. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Licensed roles require the state’s background check for an insurance license; a record does not automatically rule you out.*

Compensation Range: $110K - $130K

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We're a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can't wait to meet you.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

As a Technical Account Manager, you will own the ongoing technical relationship through the entire lifecycle of customers in your portfolio, collaborating very closely alongside the Customer Success and wider account teams. This role will serve as a trusted technical advisor responsible for defining the Braze technology strategy for customers who have purchased the TAM premium service offering and helping them unlock value from their use of the Braze platform.

Your focus will be to drive value, retention, and adoption of Braze's product through the customer lifecycle, acting as the technical counterpart between Braze and your client's product and engineering team. You will be responsible for understanding your customer's needs and proactively driving forward technical initiatives that help your customers achieve their business goals.

You'll manage a portfolio of named accounts, typically in the Enterprise and Strategic classification of accounts, a tier of customers with enterprise organizational structures and architectures, posing unique geographical, scale, and complexity challenges.

This is an opportunity to bring your experience as a product and implementation expert, business analyst, problem solver, and customer success professional along with a high level of product and technical competence, delivering high-impact engagements that drive tangible outcomes for some of Braze's most advanced customers.

* You'll be responsible for client success, partnering with the Customer Success Team to own the technical relationship for your assigned accounts and help drive technical adoption, accelerated technical value, and continued technical maturity
* Help customers successfully instrument Braze across their stack and refine that instrumentation over time as their use of Braze matures and becomes even more valuable, which in turn contributes to renewals and upsells
* Facilitate conversations regarding the customers' desired use case, conducting discovery, and recommending solutions based on their unique needs and architecture
* Support and advocate for day-to-day inquiries and requests to support optimization and value through the customer lifecycle
* Empower customer product and engineering teams to use our product as independently and efficiently as possible, communicating with customers and internal teams to explain products and solutions by delivering enablement and education
* Adopt governance practices such as creating solutions documentation and building architectural diagrams, and drive progress against key technical work streams through project management
* Instill best practice and engineering excellence amongst your customer portfolio by validating product use cases and technical feasibility for product launch and translating the customers' unique requirements to Braze's Product team

**WHO YOU ARE**

* 3-5 years client-facing experience as a TAM or in a related technical area such in Implementation, Technical Support, or Solutions Architecture, for a product offering serving Enterprise/Strategic accounts
* 3+ years of technical experience in managing complex customer environments with strong product command and technical knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, API, or Programming
* You are an excellent communicator (written and verbal skills), with demonstrable customer communication and coordination efforts, and the ability to take complex technical ideas and translate them to non-technical stakeholders
* You are a natural problem solver with a high level of intellectual curiosity and love working amongst a team to solve those problems
* You are able to maintain a high level of productivity, manage multiple competing priorities, and work effectively under the pressure of time constraints in a fast-paced, complex, and collaborative environment
* You may have bilingual skills beyond English that facilitate us talking with our global customer base in their native language. Please note that this is not a requirement for the role but something that we welcome in our team

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $90,000 and $130,500/year with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $102,000 and $145,000/year (including bonus or commission). In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company.

United States

San Francisco

As Sr. E-commerce Account Manager, you are responsible for the day-to-day management and growth of our U.S. E-commerce business, encompassing Amazon, Walmart, and other retail platforms. You will achieve commercial goals by ensuring content optimization, excellent campaign execution, and sales-driving activities that are fully aligned with our brand strategy and customer needs. Reporting to the Head of Sales Natural Foods, you are a key member of the U.S. Sales Team, collaborating closely with marketing, category, and global eCommerce colleagues to accelerate our digital growth. Taking full ownership of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, pricing, and portal operations, the Account Manager will ensure strategies are tailored to each platform, executed with precision, and aligned with Lotus’s overall business objectives. This role combines strategic and operational responsibilities to optimize the company’s digital presence, enhance brand visibility, and drive revenue growth. You will own platform health, oversee retail media planning, and translate insights into actionable strategies that drive revenue, expand distribution, and increase market share.

Apply for this job

  

### **Job description**

Daily Operations & Platform Management:

* Lead daily e-commerce operations across Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Target, Thrive, Safeway, and Kroger platforms.
* Conduct content and PDP audits, and manage Brand Store updates.
* Maintain scorecards, and pacing tools (including MTD pacing, weekly order review, forecast, and finance check-ins).
  

Commercial Planning & Financial Management:

* Execute campaign setup and launch across platforms.
* Perform optimization and bid management (keyword targeting, budget reallocation, ACoS goals).
* Leverage Amazon Marketing Cloud for insights and advanced targeting (audience testing).
* Conduct search terms analysis for trends and insights applicable to paid search strategy.
* Review Amazon AMS spend pacing and adjust strategy as needed.
* Perform paid search campaign optimization for Amazon, Walmart, Instacart, Costco, Thrive, and Target.

Reporting, Insights & Communication:

* Prepare and deliver weekly, monthly, and global business recaps.
* Provide detailed performance insights, visualizations, and actionable recommendations.
* Conduct competitive benchmarking (SOV, media trends, category performance).
* Communicate campaign impact and partner with internal teams and stakeholders.
* Refresh monthly Amazon Ads and Walmart Ads performance recaps for global connects.
  

Strategy & Innovation:

* Pilot new retail media formats and explore beta features.
* Develop audience strategies using 1P/retailer data.
* Support A/B testing (creative tests, placements tests, dayparting).
* Analyze search term reports, category trends, and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and inform content, pricing, and media strategies.
  

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Relationships:

* Coordinate with brand (global/local), insights, and category teams for media plan alignment.
* Work cross-functionally with marketing and creative to request content updates for key seasons, new item launches, and ad hoc as needed.
* Build strong relationships with platform partners ensuring deliverables and opportunities are leveraged.

* Proven experience (4-6 years) in e-commerce account management, with a track record of managing multiple accounts and platforms ideally within CPG
* Expertise in e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, and Costco, with advanced knowledge of Paid Search, DSP, Digital Shelf management, penalties, and pricing.
* Strong analytical skills to assess campaign performance and make data-driven decisions.
* Demonstrated success in managing cross-platform advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for performance.
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel or similar tools for reporting and data analysis.
* Proven ability to optimize product listings and manage compliance responsibilities on Amazon.

To be determined.

**Front Desk / Guest Services & Spa Operations Associate**

Piedmont Springs | Oakland, CA  
Part-Time | Day Shifts: 10:00 AM–4:00 PM | 5-Day Availability Required

Piedmont Springs is looking for a friendly, dependable, energetic person to join our Guest Services team.

**First, an important note: this is not a sedentary receptionist position.**

Although every member of our Guest Services team works at the front desk, this is an **active, hands-on position**. Our staff rotate between front-desk responsibilities and helping operate the spa throughout the shift.

On any given shift, you may be checking in guests and answering phones one moment, then walking through the facility to reset spa rooms, handle towels and laundry, check restrooms and common areas, restock supplies, or assist with other operational needs the next.

**If you're looking for a job where you'll spend most of your shift sitting behind a desk, this probably isn't the right position for you.**

On the other hand, if you enjoy staying busy, moving around, helping customers, working independently, and having different things to do throughout your shift, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**What You'll Do**

Our Guest Services staff are responsible for helping provide a welcoming experience for our customers while keeping the spa operating smoothly. Responsibilities include:

jobs.title: Payments Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**At a glance:** Atlanta (first seat) or San Francisco, on site · $65K to $90K in Atlanta, $85K to $115K in San Francisco, plus bonus and equity · No insurance experience needed · Payments, disputes, lending or reconciliation experience is the skill

Harper is an AI-native commercial insurance brokerage, backed by Y Combinator, with offices in San Francisco and Atlanta. We do the insurance work end to end for about 1,000 new small businesses a month, with agents and people working the same accounts.

### **Role in one line**

Resolve the money problems that would otherwise cost a small business its coverage, from one bounced payment to a batch that went wrong for hundreds.

A payment does not reconcile. A customer disputes a charge. A cancellation notice conflicts with the account record. A financed policy has no finance agreement attached. You establish what is actually true, talk to the customer, and carry the issue to a documented resolution.

### **Why now**

Payment problems are the biggest reason small businesses lose coverage with us, and it is rarely because they will not pay. Most do not know they have to, because signing and paying are separate steps. We stood up a payments unit this fall with a simple rule: the queue is at zero every day. This seat makes it a function, alongside an AI operator who automates what you do by hand.

### **What you own**

* **Payment questions, traced to the end.** Current state, amount, owner and next action, proven from the records, not from one status field.
* **Finance agreements.** Match each financed policy to its agreement and fix the ones that do not match. A policy marked paid in full that was actually financed is the error that multiplies.
* **Pending cancellations.** Work the list from the carrier and finance company portals before the cancellation date, not after. The portal’s list is the truth, not our sheet.
* **Disputes and refunds.** Gather the records, coordinate the review, tell the customer, and record the outcome. Refunds go through one channel, every time.
* **Reconciliation.** Compare the customer, payment and policy records with outside confirmation before you close anything.
* **The fix behind the fix.** Automate the reconciliation you did by hand last month, and flag the patterns that need a product or finance change.

### **What done means**

* Every conclusion names its evidence and the account or transaction it belongs to.
* Cancellation answers reflect the latest event in the chain, not the loudest notice.
* Repeat contacts go down because the issue was fixed and explained.

### **Your first 90 days**

* **Day 30:** you work the pending-cancellation list on your own and close cases with the evidence attached.
* **Day 60:** you own one recurring money problem end to end, with a weekly number.
* **Day 90:** you have automated or eliminated at least one manual reconciliation step.

### **Who thrives here**

* You have worked in payment operations, disputes, collections, lending, fraud or accounts receivable, ideally somewhere with real volume.
* You can write a crisp message to an engineer and a calm one to a frustrated business owner in the same hour.
* You notice when a number is off by one payment, and you find out why.
* You know when to keep digging and when to escalate.
* You use spreadsheets, queries or AI tools to work faster, and you can show us what you built.

### **What we teach, what you bring**

We teach premium finance, our carriers’ billing, and how a policy cancels and reinstates. You bring payments judgment, numeracy and calm on the phone with someone worried about losing their coverage.

### **Who should not apply**

* You want a back-office job with no customer conversations.
* You close cases when you transfer them.
* You decide payment or cancellation status from one field.

### **Pay, schedule and place**

* Atlanta: $65K to $90K. San Francisco: $85K to $115K. Plus bonus and equity. The difference is location; the job is the same.
* In the office Monday to Friday, starting around 8 AM local. Weekly carrier sweeps, cancellation dates and finance-company cutoffs set the rhythm, and some weeks the list is long.
* Next steps: senior payments roles, team lead, or the team that automates payments.

### **Benefits**

Health, dental and vision, plus each office’s meals and commuter or parking support.

### **How we hire (usually inside two weeks)**

* A call with our customer operations team. We reply within 48 hours at every stage.
* A work sample: three practice records that disagree about one customer’s payment. Find the truth and draft the message to the customer.
* A Super Day on site, working practice cases beside the team. We decide within 48 hours.

### **How to apply**

Send your resume and a short example of a money problem that crossed several systems or teams: how you found the real state, what you told the customer, and how you proved it was resolved.

*Harper is an equal opportunity employer. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, tell us and we will make it work. For San Francisco roles, we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.*

Compensation Range: $65K - $115K
