jobs.description:
#### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.**

At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.  
  
Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

### **Your Impact**

Ready to make your mark and help save lives? Passionate about technology sales and eager to have a real impact? Want to join a fast-moving team where your contributions truly matter?  
  
Axon is seeking a Commercial Operations Analyst to support both our Sales and Finance teams. This is a highly visible role where you'll play a key part in structuring complex deals and ensuring a seamless customer experience. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, pays close attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment — someone who doesn't wait to be told what to do next, but also values collaboration, feedback, and continuous learning.  
You'll be part of a supportive, mission-driven team that works cross-functionally with Sales, Commercial Controllership, Order Processing, and Accounts Receivable. You'll receive training, mentorship, and resources — and in turn, we'll count on you to take ownership of your work, drive things forward, and proactively solve problems as they come up.  
At Axon, we value people who think critically, take pride in their work, and care deeply about getting things right. If you're motivated, detail-oriented, and ready to grow in a dynamic environment — we'd love to meet you.

### **What You'll Do**

**Location:** 4 days a week (Tuesday-Friday) in office at Axon Hub Location (Scottsdale AZ, Seattle WA, San Francisco CA, Atlanta GA, Sterling VA, Boston MA, or NYC)

* Structure and support complex commercial deals across key accounts, working cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, and Legal to ensure efficient delivery and accurate financial outcomes.
* Maintain accuracy in Salesforce CRM, including custom contract terms, pricing, and discounting — with heavy use of Salesforce CPQ.
* Build deep expertise in Axon's product catalog, bundles, pricing structures, and approval flows — becoming a trusted resource for Sales on deal formats, non-standard quote requests, Excel supplements, and custom reporting.
* Analyze existing customer contracts to identify performance obligations, flag risks or gaps proactively, and ensure proper invoicing, documentation, and compliance.
* Participate in testing for new product launches and system updates, providing structured feedback as part of test cycles.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Order Processing to ensure timely and accurate deal execution.
* Communicate clearly with cross-functional partners — providing guidance in line with standards and policies while keeping unnecessary back-end complexity out of the conversation.
* Contribute to team-wide efforts, projects, and process improvements as needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Strong accuracy and attention to detail with low error rates on quotes and deal documentation.
* Ability to analyze contracts, identify obligations, and flag compliance risks.
* A clear, concise communicator who can simplify complex information for cross-functional stakeholders.
* Proficiency or strong aptitude in Salesforce CRM and CPQ; ability to troubleshoot independently before escalating.
* Collaborative and cross-functional by nature — comfortable working across Sales, Finance, and Legal.
* Able to work autonomously while knowing when to escalate through the right channels.
* Eager to grow into a subject-matter expert on Axon's quoting tools, pricing structures, and deal processes over time.

### **What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 3+ years in sales operations, pricing, or commercial operations
* A strong finance orientation and attention to detail, particularly with numbers and data sets
* Salesforce.com CRM platform experience (CPQ preferred)
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, SUMIFs, what-ifs, templates, etc.)
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills
* Strong time management and organizational abilities
* A proactive mindset — you take ownership of your work and seek out solutions
* A collaborative approach — you're comfortable asking questions, sharing knowledge, and working as part of a team
* A service-oriented attitude and comfort navigating cross-functional discussions
* Ability to adapt and prioritize in a fast-changing environment

Don't meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

**Important Notes**

*The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. jobs.title: Communications Operations Associate
jobs.description:
The Environmental Protection Network (EPN) is composed of more than 800 EPA alumni from across the country who volunteer their time to protect the integrity of EPA and its mission. We harness the expertise of former EPA career staff and confirmation-level appointees from Democratic and Republican administrations to provide the unique perspective of former regulators with decades of historical knowledge and subject matter expertise.

EPN is currently focused on building, defending and reimagining the capacity of environmental health agencies and the communities they serve to truly address the most urgent health and environmental crises.

* We work to ensure that EPA advances policies, programs, budgets, and institutional changes to address climate and environmental injustices, as well as other pressing public health needs.
* We provide pro bono capacity-building technical assistance and training to frontline communities, NGOs, and under-resourced state/local/tribal government agencies.
* We offer pro bono support to civil servants.
* We educate Congress and serve as a critical resource for facts, objective analysis, and scientific rigor for reporters and NGOs.

**Priority Deadline December 4th**

**About The Position:**

Effective public communication is central to EPN's mission. Our Public Affairs team helps people understand how EPA's work affects their health, communities, and daily lives, while bringing independent expertise to discussions about how environmental protections can meet changing political, economic, and technological realities. Behind timely media responses, effective outreach, and clear public-facing materials are dependable systems and careful coordination.

EPN is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Communications Operations Associate to make that work possible. As a central coordinator and project manager for our growing Public Affairs team, this person will connect people, information, deadlines, and deliverables; anticipate needs; and keep important work moving. The role combines communications workflow management, reporter intake and follow-up, managing contact and media-tracking databases, publication and distribution of communications materials, proactive scheduling and administrative support. Reporting to EPN's Senior Director of Public Affairs, the Associate works with communications and policy staff, volunteer experts, and outside partners to ensure accurate, timely execution.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

### **1. Communications Workflow and Project Coordination-**

* Independently coordinate the Public Affairs team's day-to-day workflow, maintaining an up-to-date Asana task tracker and editorial/production calendar for releases, newsletters, campaigns, and other deliverables.
* Track assignments, owners, approvals, dependencies, and deadlines; anticipate competing demands, identify bottlenecks, and help resolve routine conflicts before they delay work.
* Coordinate handoffs among communications staff, policy colleagues, volunteers, and outside contractors; follow up proactively and close the loop on outstanding tasks.
* Document and improve repeatable workflows, checklists, templates, and team systems.

### **2. Administrative and Scheduling Support-**

* Provide proactive administrative and scheduling support to Public Affairs leadership and the broader team, coordinating meetings and interviews across multiple calendars and participants.
* Manage invitations, meeting links, reminders, agendas, shared materials, notes, and action items as needed; follow through on next steps.
* Organize shared files, contacts, and distribution lists; prepare materials and handle routine logistical requests with accuracy and discretion.
* Anticipate routine needs, recognize when competing requests require a decision, and raise issues promptly with the appropriate colleagues.

### **3. Press Intake, Reporter Coordination, and Distribution-**

* Triage incoming press inquiries, acknowledge or route them promptly, assess urgency and deadlines, and maintain complete records of requests and follow-up needs.
* Coordinate interviews and volunteer expert availability; help ensure reporters receive approved materials and timely responses.
* Execute distribution of approved press releases and the weekly news tipsheet; coordinate related website updates, internal notifications, and follow-up tasks.
* Research and verify journalist contacts and outlets; maintain media lists, including bounced addresses, unsubscribes, duplicates, and targeted list updates.
* **Develop and strengthen relationships with reporters through responsive communication, familiarity with their beats and interests, and opportunities to connect them with relevant EPN experts and resources.**

### **4. Media Tracking, Data Entry, and Reporting-**

* Review media-monitoring feeds, team channels, and other sources daily for relevant EPN coverage and press activity; flag items requiring action.
* Enter and cross-reference reporter inquiries, interviews, resulting coverage, volunteer experts, and related outreach in EPN's tracking systems so records are complete, searchable, and connected.
* Research, verify, and update volunteer expert information used for reporter coordination; conduct routine database quality checks, including duplicate resolution, contact updates, and consistent tagging and links.
* Prepare regular press activity summaries, coverage and outreach metrics, and accurate data pulls for team reporting and planning.

### **5. Publishing and Communications Production-**

* Format, proofread, test, and publish approved press releases, EPN in the News items, and other website updates using EPN's content management system.
* Coordinate production and distribution of the weekly volunteer newsletter, EPN in Action, and other recurring communications, working with content leads on submissions, approvals, formatting, links, scheduling, and final checks.
* Prepare reports, fact sheets, and other communications p

jobs.title: 340B Implementation Quality Assurance Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** 340B Implementation Quality Assurance Analyst

**Location:** Remote  
**Vertical / Department:** Customer Engagement / Implementation & Onboarding

**Reports To:** Implementation Manager  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**Position Summary:**

A **340B Implementation Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst** ensures that a covered entity's 340B Drug Discount Program is implemented, operated, and maintained in full compliance with HRSA regulations, internal policies, and program integrity standards. This role blends compliance oversight, process implementation, and quality assurance to ensure the 340B program delivers intended savings and meets all regulatory and internal standards. The role is to oversee the implementation, monitoring, and compliance of the 340B program, including audit activities, process validation, and risk mitigation to prevent duplicate discounts, diversion, and eligibility errors**.**

**Program Compliance & Auditing:**

* Conduct regular internal audits of 340B Office of Pharmacy Affairs Information System (OPAIS) records, retail pharmacies (entity-owned and contract), and Medicaid claims to ensure adherence to HRSA requirements
* Validate patient, provider, and drug eligibility for all 340B transactions
* Review and interpret state Medicaid billing requirements and compare against claims data
* Participate in external 340B program audits and prepare data/documentation for review

**Implementation & Process Oversight:**

* Develop and maintain 340B policies, procedures, and workflows for purchasing, referral capture, and contract pharmacy management
* Administer referral prescription capture processes and ensure documentation supports eligibility
* Monitor contract pharmacy portals for missed claims, investigate denials/reversals, and coordinate remediation
* Configure and maintain eligible provider tables, location/site mapping, and excluded NDCs/drugs in compliance with internal and HRSA standards

**Quality Assurance & Risk Management:**

* Identify compliance risks, prevent diversion, and ensure consistent processes across all points of service
* Develop training programs (e.g., 340B University OnDemand) for staff on 340B procedures and inventory management
* Monitor regulatory updates and communicate implications to program operations

**Reporting & Collaboration:**

* Generate program utilization, savings, and exception reports for management and stakeholders
* Collaborate with IT, audit, accounting, and pharmacy teams to share data, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance
* Provide data, reports, and insights to support other business units

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma/GED; pharmacy or healthcare-related degree preferred
* 1–3+ years in 340B program work; prior QA, compliance, or pharmacy operations experience preferred

* In-depth knowledge of HRSA 340B regulations and program mechanics
* Proficiency in Excel, SQL, data analysis, and 340B software
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Implementation quality scores.
* Number of post-go-live defects identified.
* Defect resolution turnaround times.
* First-pass testing success rates.
* Accuracy of implementation validations.
* Compliance audit findings.
* Client implementation satisfaction scores.
* On-time project delivery support.
* Reduction in implementation rework.
* Effectiveness of risk identification and mitigation.

**What We Offer:**

* Health insurance
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental and Vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off

**Why Join Pillr Health?**

As a leading 340B Third-Party Administrator, we help covered entities maximize program compliance, improve patient access to care, and strengthen healthcare outcomes.

* Review and improve marketing processes for efficiency, scale, and effectiveness.
* Work with Product and Revenue Cycle on de-identified data for benchmarks and proof points.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Share of deals with a valid original source.
* Report accuracy and on-time delivery.
* SDR and AE lead response time.
* Data quality on the named account list.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Required

* Deep HubSpot experience: workflows, lifecycle management, lead scoring, reporting, and CRM data
* Hands-on use of AI tools to speed up reporting, list building, and campaign setup

* Experience building funnel and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions
* Comfort working with Sales on definitions, handoffs, and SLAs

jobs.title: Project Manager, Technology Services
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Strategic Operations Lead
jobs.description:
**About Team / Role**

This role leads complex, high-impact strategic projects, operational transformations, and technology-enabled initiatives across Health, Corporate Payments, and Mobility. The role manages advanced initiatives from definition through implementation and stabilization, often spanning multiple business lines, operational functions, systems, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  
  

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Strategic Operations Lead translates complex or ambiguous business needs into structured programs of work, establishes governance and accountability, manages significant risks and dependencies, and drives decisions necessary to achieve intended business outcomes.

  
  

The role combines advanced project management and operational expertise to identify and lead opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, redesign, or eliminate inefficient processes. This role also advances AI and automation capabilities across the organization by identifying high-value opportunities, leading complex implementations, and ensuring measurable and sustainable business benefits.

  
  

**How You'll Make an Impact**

  
  

### **PROJECT MANAGEMENT & DELIVERY**

* ### **Lead complex, high-impact projects and operational transformations, including initiatives spanning multiple business lines, functions, systems, or workstreams, from definition through implementation and stabilization.**
* ### **Translate ambiguous or evolving business needs into clear scope, objectives, deliverables, governance, resource requirements, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.**
* ### **Establish and lead project governance, executive reporting, decision management, and risk and issue escalation appropriate to the complexity and impact of assigned initiatives.**
* ### **Coordinate cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders, establishing clear ownership and driving decisions where priorities, requirements, or accountabilities conflict.**
* ### **Anticipate and manage significant risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and downstream impacts, developing recommendations and corrective actions when project health is at risk.**
* ### **Ensure operational requirements, financial and operational controls, capacity, business continuity, training, documentation, and implementation readiness are addressed before launch.**
* ### **Lead implementation and stabilization and validate that intended outcomes, sustainable business ownership, and appropriate performance measures are established.**

  
  

### **PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & OPERATIONAL TRANSFORMATION**

  
  

* ### **Lead complex process improvement and operating-model initiatives spanning multiple teams, business lines, systems, or functional boundaries.**
* ### **Analyze workflows, data, financial exposure, operational incidents, control findings, and stakeholder feedback to identify systemic issues and root causes.**
* ### **Design and implement future-state processes that improve capacity, quality, service, controls, risk management, and scalability.**
* ### **Identify opportunities to standardize or consolidate processes across business lines where common solutions can reduce fragmentation, duplication, and manual effort.**
* ### **Establish measurable business outcomes and validate that expected operational, financial, capacity, risk, and service benefits are realized.**

  

### **AI, AUTOMATION & TECHNOLOGY ENABLEMENT**

  
  

* ### **Identify and lead high-value opportunities to apply AI, automation, analytics, and technology across business lines to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy and risk detection, increase capacity, and strengthen management visibility.**
* ### **Partner with operational leaders, Product, Technology, and automation resources to translate complex business problems into scalable technology-enabled solutions.**
* ### **Lead complex automation initiatives through requirements, prioritization, testing, implementation, controls, adoption, and stabilization.**
* ### **Challenge existing processes before automation to ensure technology supports effective future-state workflows rather than replicating inefficient manual activity.**
* ### **Establish measurable outcomes automation initiatives, including capacity released, financial benefit, quality and service improvement, risk reduction, and control effectiveness.**
* ### **Ensure appropriate human oversight, data handling, controls, governance, and sustainable operational ownership are incorporated into AI and automation solutions.**

  

### **PORTFOLIO, PRIORITIZATION & GOVERNANCE**

  
  

* ### **Maintain visibility across assigned strategic projects, transformation initiatives, and technology-enabled work and identify dependencies or conflicts across the portfolio.**
* ### **Partner with leadership to evaluate and prioritize initiatives based on strategic alignment, business impact, risk, resource requirements, dependencies, and expected return.**
* ### **Provide leadership with clear recommendations when competing priorities, capacity constraints, risks, or dependencies require trade-off decisions.**
* ### **Establish reporting that provides concise visibility into project health, milestones, risks, decisions, dependencies, benefits, and outcomes.**
* ### **Identify patterns across projects and operational issues that indicate broader systemic risks or improvement opportunities.**

  

### **STAKEHOLDER & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

  
  

* ### **Build effective partnerships across Health, Corporate Payments, Mobility, Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Commercial, and other functions required to deliver complex initiatives.**
* ### **Lead cross-functional working sessions, governance forums, and executive discussions that drive decisions, resolve barriers, and maintain accountability.**
* ### **Translate complex operational, technical, financial, and project information into clear options and recommendations for senior leadership.

At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Clinical Operations Coordinator, accountable for supporting the operational delivery of a variety of contracted services in a Clinical Trial. These services include Rater Training and Monitoring activities (training deployment, management, and in-study reporting/calibration), Clinician Network Management (ensuring quality and consistency across global clinical interviews), Data Management (opening and resolving data queries), and Scale Management (binder creation, translations, logistics & shipping).

The daily workload for the above functional areas will fluctuate throughout the life cycle of a Clinical Trial. The Clinical Operations Coordinator will be cross trained to support multiple functional areas, flexibly jumping in to assist study teams according to their changing bandwidth needs.

* Work with study teams across a variety of functional areas to ease bandwidth strain on Coordinator responsibilities detailed below.

* Point of contact for clinician/rater support questions.
* Direct communication with site coordinators at clinical settings, activity and communication tracking and general support throughout study.

* Bachelor's degree or 1+ years of related experience.

* Microsoft Office proficiency.

* Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
* Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
* Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
* Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

We bring our whole selves to work every day. We're courageous and we deliver together. We're passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We're brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

jobs.description:
*USA (Remote)*

**Job Description**
-------------------

Founded in 2008, OPTiMO is an experienced consulting firm specializing in world-class, enterprise-level application development, system integration, and digital design. Our clients span the public and private sector, and we strive for excellence both in our design work and service to our clients.

We are looking to add experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Analysts to support a client SAP migration-to-cloud initiative. In this role, the QA Analyst will evaluate products, systems, integrations, and business processes to ensure they meet requirements and quality standards throughout migration and release activities.

The QA Analyst will develop and execute test cases and scripts, document results and defects, support end-to-end validation, collaborate with functional and technical teams, and retest fixes. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and consistent communication with project team members and client stakeholders. SAP experience is desired.

### **Requirements**

* BA/BS degree.
* At least 5 years of Quality Assurance/software testing experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience appropriate to the assignment.
* Experience working with small teams in dynamic environments with regular client and project-team interaction.
* Strong analytical and technical skills to identify, reproduce, document, and troubleshoot issues.
* Experience developing and executing software test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and enhancement requests.
* Experience documenting and communicating test results, defects, supporting evidence, retest results, and testing status.
* Demonstrated knowledge of test methodologies including functional, integration, regression, system, end-to-end, and user acceptance support testing as applicable.
* Ability to participate in all phases of the testing lifecycle and collaborate with developers, business analysts, systems analysts, business users, and other functional and technical resources.
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile or other structured delivery methodologies.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and meticulous attention to detail.

### **QA Testing Responsibilities**

* Review requirements, designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, interfaces, and business processes to understand expected behavior and identify test conditions.
* Develop, maintain, and execute test cases and scripts for functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and migration-related validation activities.
* Validate business processes, system behavior, interfaces, integrations, and data as applicable to the assigned test scope.
* Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected and actual results, supporting evidence, severity/impact information, and traceability to applicable requirements.
* Collaborate with functional and technical teams to investigate defects, support issue resolution, and retest fixes.
* Perform regression testing to identify unintended impacts from changes and defect corrections.
* Maintain testing evidence, test results, traceability, and other QA artifacts in accordance with project processes.
* Communicate testing progress, blockers, risks, defects, and observations to the QA Lead and applicable project stakeholders.
* Participate in requirements/design reviews, defect triage, working sessions, demonstrations, and other project activities as needed.
* Support reusable test assets, lessons learned, and continuous improvement of project testing practices.

### **Desired Skills**

* Experience testing SAP solutions, SAP implementations, upgrades, or migration initiatives.
* Experience supporting cloud migration, modernization, or large enterprise system integration efforts.
* Experience validating data migration, interfaces, integrations, batch processes, and end-to-end business workflows.
* Experience with automated software testing tools or frameworks; automation experience is desired where applicable.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar requirements, test management, collaboration, and defect-tracking platforms.
* Experience supporting federal government or other large enterprise programs.
* Experience with Microsoft Office platform.

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager - Public Sector Defense
jobs.description:
Customer Success is a growing capability at TomTom, bringing pre-sales and post-sales together around the customer with adoption, value and growth as its focus. In this role, you will help define what excellent enterprise customer success looks like, strengthen how TomTom works across teams and regions, and build durable partnerships that expand the use of our location technology

Enterprise customers depend on reliable location technology to run critical products, services and operations. Our maps, traffic, routing, navigation, APIs and software development kits help them solve complex location challenges, and your job is to ensure that technology delivers measurable value from the first discovery conversation through adoption, expansion and renewal

You lead one or more of TomTom's most strategic enterprise relationships, often spanning multiple business units, use cases and regions. Together with the account manager, you own the customer's success, retention and long-term revenue growth. You are the account manager's counterpart for everything beyond the commercial deal: whether our capabilities fit the customer's business problem, whether the solution can be delivered as promised, whether it is adopted, and where TomTom can create value next. You connect the customer's business and technical leaders with TomTom's product, engineering, delivery, support and Partner Commercial Growth teams, creating one coordinated experience across the full relationship

You do not run the delivery project; the responsible program or delivery manager owns the committed scope and schedule. You do not carry a direct sales quota, but you are expected to influence and help deliver revenue growth within the customers you lead. Success is measured through customer outcomes, adoption, retention, qualified expansion pipeline, revenue growth influence, predictable execution, executive alignment and customer trust. You are accountable for moving the customer relationship forward, even when you do not directly own every contributing team

### **What you'll need**

* A strong technical and business foundation, gained through a relevant degree or equivalent experience, with practical familiarity in location technology, mapping, traffic, routing, geospatial platforms, APIs, cloud services or enterprise software
* Knowledge of public sector and defense customer needs, including mission-critical operations, government procurement, security and compliance requirements, data sovereignty, interoperability, accessibility, long acquisition cycles and the need to work across agencies, programs, integrators and partners
* Seven years or more working with complex enterprise customers in customer success, program management, solution consulting, product management, pre-sales or a related role, including responsibility for a customer journey from discovery through operational use
* A record of growing a strategic account, improving adoption or helping win an enterprise program as the customer and technical lead alongside Sales. You can explain the customer problem, your role, the measurable outcome and what changed because of your work
* Fluent English, with strong written, presentation and executive communication skills. Additional languages are an advantage for global accounts
* Credibility with technical and business audiences. You can work with architects and developers, advise program and product leaders, and engage procurement and executives with clear, practical recommendations
* Business acumen: you understand how location technology creates operational, product and commercial value, and you explain it in the customer's language
* Leadership without a reporting line: you align account teams, product groups, delivery teams, support functions and partners around one plan, using evidence, preparation and clear ownership
* Strong judgment, autonomy and comfort with change. You can prioritize across competing customer needs, surface risk early and stay effective in an evolving organization
* Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings, workshops, executive reviews and internal planning

### **What you'll do**

* Lead the customer relationship on our side: create one success plan across pre-sales, onboarding, adoption, operations and expansion, with clear outcomes, owners, risks and next steps
* Build the account and success plan with the account manager: understand the customer's strategy, identify priority business outcomes and use cases, map whitespace across business units and regions, and define the revenue opportunities we will pursue together. You lead the customer, solution and adoption side of growth; the account manager leads the commercial close

jobs.title: Call Center Manager
jobs.description:
**Call Center Manager**
-----------------------

**Omari Construction Group – Remote**  
**Job Type:** Full-Time Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually + bonuses

**About Us**
------------

Omari Construction is a growing construction company specializing in commercial construction, luxury residential design-build, and exterior remodeling and insurance restoration. We are committed to delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and results across every division.

At Omari, we value **integrity, innovation, and performance**. We are seeking motivated professionals who take ownership, lead with accountability, and thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**About the Position**
----------------------

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and results-driven **Call Center Manager** to build, lead, and optimize our outbound call center operations.

This individual will be responsible for managing call center representatives, developing effective lead-generation strategies, overseeing appointment scheduling, maintaining accurate CRM records, and driving measurable performance.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong call center management experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to develop scalable processes that support company growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Call Center Leadership & Operations**

* Build, manage, and continuously improve daily call center operations.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and coach call center representatives.
* Establish daily calling priorities, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions.
* Develop call scripts, training materials, and standardized operating procedures.
* Ensure consistent call center coverage and efficient appointment scheduling.

**Lead Generation & Appointment Management**

* Oversee outbound calling campaigns to generate qualified appointments for insurance inspections and retail home improvement estimates.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage quality lead sources and calling lists.
* Monitor lead quality, appointment conversion rates, and follow-up activity.
* Coordinate with sales leadership to ensure appointments are properly scheduled, tracked, and completed.
* Maintain accurate lead records, call dispositions, and appointment outcomes.
* Optimize calling strategies to improve contact rates and appointment performance.

**Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Monitor daily call volume, representative productivity, appointment conversion rates, and no-show rates.
* Review daily and weekly call center performance reports.
* Maintain individual representative scorecards and identify coaching opportunities.
* Provide weekly performance updates to company leadership.
* Develop automated reporting tools and dashboards to track department performance.

**Systems Management & Process Improvement**

* Oversee the administration and optimization of RingCentral, RingCX, and related communication systems.
* Maintain accurate customer and appointment records within AccuLynx CRM.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tools, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive Call Center Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure calling lists, CRM records, and reporting systems remain accurate and organized.
* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to improve efficiency and customer experience.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Monitor call quality, representative performance, and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable telemarketing regulations, including Do Not Call requirements.
* Review call outcomes, lead classifications, and appointment records for accuracy.
* Identify operational issues and implement corrective action.
* Maintain a high standard of professionalism and customer communication.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5+ years of experience in call center operations, outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing or supervising a call center team.
* Demonstrated success improving call center productivity, appointment conversion, and team performance.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development skills.
* Experience managing outbound calling campaigns and lead-generation strategies.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms, call center software, and performance reporting tools.
* Experience with RingCentral, RingCX, AccuLynx, or similar platforms preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet performance objectives.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, roofing, or insurance restoration is a plus.

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to develop a productive, efficient, and scalable call center operation.

Key performance objectives include:

* Supporting representative productivity targets of approximately **200–300 outbound dials per day**.
* Driving an average of **2–4 qualified appointments per representative per day**.
* Maintaining accurate CRM records and complete call dispositions.
* Improving appointment completion rates and minimizing no-shows.
* Delivering consistent, accurate weekly reporting.
* Developing documented processes that support long-term operational growth.

**Compensation & Performance Bonus**
------------------------------------

**Base Compensation: $50,000–$60,000 annually**, based on experience and qualifications.

In addition to base compensation, this position offers the opportunity to earn **up to $30,000 in annual performance-based bonuses**, subject to the terms of the applicable compensation agreement.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - US
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote - United States

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Customer Success

  

**About You**

You’re a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You’re a self-starter who’s good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You’ve worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they’re happy they partnered with you. Further, you’re a curious person, and you’d love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

**About Us**
------------

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.
  
  
Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.
  
  
We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.
  
  
Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

**About the Position**

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

* Repaying our customers’ trust through ensuring they get live with our product and are thrilled with the results
* Understand the needs and roles within the enterprise organizations we work with and help to manage prioritizations and misalignments. If two people within a customer ask for different things, your team must understand how to prioritize for the success of the organization without hurting feelings
* Helping craft and dictate both internal and external narratives for what’s needed to make a customer successful
* Effectively asking for and managing engineering time to ensure important work for customers is prioritized and unimportant requests are resolved with minimal to no engineering resources
* Fielding and troubleshooting customer support requests
* Creating and updating customer documentation and training materials as needed
* Always looking for new ways you can make our integration process more robust and make customers feel even more successful

  

**Requirements**

* A minimum of three years professional experience dealing directly with customers and large organizations in a role within customer success, technical account management, or solutions consulting
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Know what an API is and have interacted with them before
* Excellent ability to quickly understand the different roles in an organization, focus on the ones most important to a task, and craft clear narrative to get people behind your ideas
* Ability to convince and motivate those around you to do what you know is right
* Enjoy interacting with customers and solving new problems daily
* Ability and desire to learn quickly, think outside the box, and come up with solutions to problems

**How we handle your data.** By submitting this application, you acknowledge that Constructor will collect and process the personal data you provide for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for this role. If you are not selected, we will retain your data for a limited period as described in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. After that period your data will be deleted or anonymized.

jobs.description:
**The Opportunity:**

The Client Service Delivery Manager is a key leadership role within our Customer Success organization, accountable for the day-to-day operation, responsiveness, and quality of support and ongoing services delivered to existing Flextrack clients.

You will lead client-facing service and platform specialists, oversee support requests, incidents, escalations, and configuration needs, and coordinate with Product, Solutions, and Technology teams to drive timely resolution. You will provide clients with clear communication, reliable follow-through, and predictable service outcomes.

This role is ideal for a hands-on, customer-focused leader who combines enterprise SaaS support management, operational discipline, technical aptitude, and team development.

  

**What Success Looks Like:**

Within your first six months, you will have:

  

* Established clear ownership, intake, triage, escalation paths, and service management processes, and backlog management for client support requests.
* Implemented consistent reporting on support volumes, SLA performance, response and resolution times, ticket aging, backlog, and service quality.
* Established a predictable cadence of operational service reviews with key clients and internal stakeholders.
* Reduced recurring support issues through root cause analysis, knowledge sharing, documentation, and coordinated corrective actions.
* Improved team effectiveness through coaching, workload management, resource coverage, and clear performance expectations.
* Established effective handoffs and escalation processes with Product, Solutions, and Technology teams for defects, configuration requests, and enhancements.

  

**Day-to-Day You Will:**

Own Client Support Operations

  

* Lead the daily operation of Flextrack’s client support function, ensuring timely and effective responses to inquiries, incidents, and service requests.
* Set, monitor, and improve service-level targets for response, resolution, and quality in accordance with client commitments.
* Ensure incoming support requests are categorized, prioritized, assigned, escalated, and resolved with clear ownership.
* Oversee incident management, including major incident coordination, client updates, service restoration, and post-incident reviews.
* Review ticket volumes, aging, recurring issues, and client feedback to identify opportunities for permanent resolution and process improvement.
* Manage staffing coverage, workload distribution, and operational readiness to provide reliable support across the client base.

  

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Service Team

  

* Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to client-facing support and service specialists, including Customer Success Managers where assigned to the role.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.
* Support team development through coaching, performance management, and career growth opportunities.
* Establish and reinforce best practices for ticket ownership, client communication, documentation, and service delivery.

  

Manage Client Requests and Cross-Functional Resolution

  

* Own the end-to-end management of client support requests, configuration changes, and service issues, coordinating with Product, Solutions, and Technology teams to ensure timely resolution and clear communication of commitments.
* Ensure requests are accurately scoped, prioritized, assigned, tracked, and communicated to clients, with clear accountability for next steps.
* Partner with Product and Technology to distinguish configuration issues from product defects and enhancements, and to coordinate technical resolution without assuming ownership of the product roadmap or development resources.
* Build scalable request management and handoff processes that support predictable outcomes and an exceptional client experience.

  

Build Trusted Operational Client Partnerships

  

* Develop strong working relationships with client program administrators, operational stakeholders, and executive sponsors as appropriate.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex service issues, coordinating resolution, timely updates, and follow-up actions.
* Lead regular operational service reviews covering support performance, open issues, risks, recurring incidents, and agreed action items; contribute service updates to strategic business reviews led by Customer Success.

**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.

**About Transportli**

Transportli is an online shipping marketplace connecting individuals and businesses with transportation providers across the United States.

Our platform helps customers compare shipping quotes, communicate with carriers, and arrange transportation services, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) freight, expedited shipping, and auto transport.

We’re building a simpler, more transparent shipping experience through technology, competitive pricing, and reliable customer support.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused **Freight Support Manager** to oversee customer support operations and help ensure a smooth shipping experience for customers and transportation providers using the Transportli marketplace.

The ideal candidate has experience in freight transportation, strong communication skills, and the ability to resolve shipping-related issues efficiently.

**Customer Support & Freight Assistance**

* Assist customers with shipping requests, quotes, and booking procedures.

* Maintain accurate shipment records and customer communication histories.

**Marketplace Operations**

* Monitor incoming shipping requests and customer inquiries.
* Follow up with customers who have received quotes but have not completed bookings.
* Identify opportunities to improve quote acceptance and booking conversion rates.
* Help transportation providers navigate the Transportli platform.
* Collaborate with the product and operations teams to improve marketplace functionality.

**Performance & Quality Management**

* Maintain high customer satisfaction and response-time standards.
* Track support performance, recurring issues, and customer feedback.
* Develop and improve customer support procedures.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic reports on support activities and performance.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in freight transportation, logistics operations, or customer support.
* Understanding of U.S. freight transportation, particularly LTL and expedited shipping.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with CRM systems, transportation management systems, or customer support software.
* Ability to handle multiple customer requests and prioritize urgent issues.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with U.S. freight carriers and transportation marketplaces.
* Knowledge of LTL freight classes, NMFC classifications, and accessorial charges.
* Experience in auto transport or expedited freight operations.
* Familiarity with freight claims and shipping documentation.
* Experience improving customer conversion rates and retention.
* Previous experience with digital marketplaces or logistics technology platforms.

**What We Offer**

* Remote work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a growing transportation technology platform.
* Collaborative and supportive team.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Direct involvement in improving customer experience and marketplace operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* **First Response Time:** Speed of responding to customer inquiries.
* **Customer Satisfaction (CSAT):** Quality of customer support interactions.
* **Quote-to-Booking Conversion:** Percentage of shipping requests converted into bookings.
* **Issue Resolution Time:** Efficiency in resolving customer and shipment-related issues.
* **Shipment Support Quality:** Accuracy of shipment information and timely communication.
* **Customer Retention:** Percentage of customers returning to use the platform.

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief introduction highlighting their experience in U.S. freight transportation and customer support.

jobs.title: Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Rhythm Energy**
-----------------------

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company on a mission to make clean energy simple, accessible, and affordable for everyone.

We combine deep energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver innovative, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions. From helping customers take control of their electricity choices to developing new products and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future, we're rethinking how people interact with energy.

We're a fast-growing, mission-driven team that values ownership, collaboration, and innovation. We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and empower our people to solve meaningful problems and make a real impact.

At Rhythm, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of energy while building products, systems, and experiences that make a difference for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring an **Operations Analyst** to help manage and improve the systems and workflows that connect Rhythm with our utilities, vendors, and external partners.

You'll take ownership of critical operational processes, including transaction exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests. Working across internal teams and external partners, you'll investigate issues, resolve exceptions, and ensure our operations run accurately and efficiently.

This role goes beyond day-to-day execution. You'll analyze operational data, identify recurring issues, and help implement improvements that enable Rhythm to grow and scale.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to build a career in operations within a fast-growing energy company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and manage operational workflows, including account exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests.
* Work with our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) vendor, utilities, and internal teams to investigate and resolve transaction exceptions.
* Analyze operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
* Communicate system bugs, operational risks, and business feedback to internal stakeholders and department leadership.
* Support operational requests within established service-level agreements (SLAs), ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Partner with your manager and cross-functional teams to execute prioritized initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Document workflows, processes, and resolutions to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 1+ year of experience in backend operations, transaction management, operational workflows, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with operational data and reporting tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and technologies quickly.
* A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in retail energy, electricity supply, utilities, or another transaction-intensive industry.
* Familiarity with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems and transaction management.
* Experience with customer service ticketing platforms, EDI management software, or data visualization tools.
* Experience testing operational workflows and documenting business processes.
* Interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy innovation.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Operational workflows and transaction exceptions are managed accurately and within established SLAs.
* Failed orders and account exceptions are investigated and resolved with minimal disruption to customers and internal teams.
* Recurring operational issues are identified through data analysis and translated into actionable improvements.
* Processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable as Rhythm grows.
* Internal teams and external partners receive clear, timely communication on issues and resolutions.
* You independently manage your responsibilities and become a trusted contributor to the Operations team.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**
--------------------------------

* **Meaningful ownership.** Manage critical processes that directly impact Rhythm's customers and business operations.
* **Career growth.** Build your expertise in operations, energy markets, systems integration, and process improvement.
* **Analytical challenges.** Investigate complex issues, work with operational data, and turn insights into improvements.
* **Cross-functional exposure.** Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, vendors, and external partners.
* **Remote flexibility.** Work remotely within the United States while contributing to a collaborative team.
* **Our culture.** We're friendly, transparent, and value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
* **Make a difference.** Help build a more efficient, technology-driven energy company focused on a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Clinical Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Included Health Clinical Practice/Clinical Org practice—spanning Virtual Care, Population Health, and emerging service lines. Your primary focus will be on instructional design, transforming complex clinical policies and workflows into engaging digital learning content (eLearning modules, video simulations, and interactive scenarios). As a core pillar of the training team, you will manage our Learning Management System (LMS), collect and analyze training data, and act as a dedicated learner assistant to ensure seamless educational rollouts.

While your primary focus is content creation and support, you will also assist in cross-covering live training sessions for various onboarding cohorts. You will be an AI-forward builder who uses AI tools and other technologies to accelerate content development, reduce manual work, and embed just-in-time support into the clinician experience. This role is ideal for an instructional design professional who excels at behind-the-scenes content creation and LMS administration, yet remains flexible enough to step into the room to support live learners and educators when needed.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Content Creation, Execution & Maintenance**

* Prepare, use, and update existing training materials (slides, facilitator guides, job aids, scenarios, and exercises) created and/or approved by the Senior Clinical Training Specialists, Manager, and CKE team.
* Surface content gaps or inconsistencies you see during training (e.g., slide doesn’t match CRC, workflow screenshot is outdated) so they can be prioritized for formal updates.
* Use LMS and training tools at a proficient user level (launching sessions, tracking completions, pulling basic reports).
* Design instruction based on clinical workflows in collaboration with CKE team and stakeholders.

**2. Cross-Service Line Clinical Facilitation**

* Deliver live virtual training (group sessions, small-group breakouts, and 1:1 coaching) for clinical new hires and tenured clinicians across Virtual Care and Population Health service lines.
* Facilitate a mix of foundational, workflow, and application-based sessions (e.g., documentation practice, care plan workflows, triage scenarios, navigation workflows) using adult learning best practices.
* Support or co-lead clinical simulations, mock calls, and role plays, observing performance, giving clear, behavior-based feedback, and escalating clinical safety concerns appropriately.
* Flex into different service lines as hiring volume, redesign work, or audit findings shift the training portfolio — maintaining sufficient cross-training to be safe and effective wherever you are deployed.

**3. Cohort Support & Learner Coaching**

* Partner with the Senior Clinical Training Specialists to execute the day-to-day plan for new hire cohorts (agenda, timing, logistics, handoff points).
* Monitor learner engagement, participation, and performance during sessions; identify individuals who need additional support and provide targeted coaching or remediation as directed by the Senior(s) and Manager.
* Use rubrics, checklists, and competency tools to document learner progress and escalate concerns regarding readiness for independent work.
* Contribute to a psychologically safe learning environment where clinicians can practice, make mistakes, and receive direct but supportive feedback.

**4. Data, Feedback, and Continuous Improvement**

* Capture and share learner feedback, questions, and pain points from the classroom in a structured way to inform curriculum improvements and service-line decisions.
* Create and monitor formal metrics for learning and successful application of skills.
* Use available data (e.g., knowledge checks, simulation scores, survey results) to describe trends you’re seeing in learner performance and experience, and to validate where additional coaching or clarification is needed.
* Participate in course audits, pilots, and retrospectives, giving concrete recommendations on pacing, activities, and scaffolding from the trainer perspective.
* Champion a “Spirit of Inquiry” by modeling curiosity, evidence-based practice, and openness to feedback in your own facilitation.

**5. Surge Support & Operational Flex**

* During surge periods or large cohorts, act as co-facilitator/producer, managing breakout rooms, chat questions, tech issues, and basic operational workflows so Senior Trainers can focus on high-complexity clinical teaching and stakeholder interactions.
* Lead or co-lead baseline operational sessions (e.g., navigation of training environments, structured documentation practice, non-clinical workflows) when appropriate to free up Senior bandwidth.
* Adhere to and reinforce capacity rules and surge protocols defined by the Manager and Senior Trainers (e.g., ratio rules, blackout dates, backup facilitator coverage).

Experience:

* 2+ years of experience in formal clinical/healthcare training, precepting, clinical education, or adult learning.
* Specifically, instructional design, LMS management, data collection, learner assistance, etc.

Facilitation & communication:

jobs.title: Go To Market Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**Go to Market Enablement Manager**

DefenseStorm is looking for a Go-to-Market Enablement Manager to help our Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams turn strategy into consistent execution. You’ll build and run the programs, playbooks, and practical learning experiences that help our teams ramp faster, tell a clear and differentiated story, and guide customers from initial discovery through renewal and expansion.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for a systems thinker who can set the enablement roadmap, build the program, craft the workflows, lead the workshops, and facilitate the coaching. Working closely with GTM leadership, Product Marketing, Product, Revenue Operations, and technical subject matter experts, you’ll enable our teams to translate complex cybersecurity capabilities into customer-centered conversations that resonate with banking technology, security, and risk leaders.

You’ll also make AI a practical part of how our GTM teams work—improving preparation, content, coaching, and repeatable workflows without sacrificing accuracy, judgment, or human connection. Success means more than training completion: it means observable behavior change and measurable improvement in GTM effectiveness.  
  
**Location**

* Alpharetta, GA
* Remote

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assess skills, content, and workflow gaps across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Partner with leadership within the first 90 days to prioritize programs tied to pipeline creation & sales execution, then customer retention & expansion.
* Design structured learning paths with clear milestones, practical exercises, and certifications. Combine live instruction, SME sessions, call reviews, role-play, and self-directed learning, so readiness is demonstrated—not just checked off.
* Partner with Product Marketing, Product, Solutions Engineering, and Collaborative SOC experts to help teams explain DefenseStorm’s platform, differentiation, and customer outcomes. Equip teams to connect cybersecurity, risk, and governance capabilities to the priorities of bank and credit union buyers.
* Translate positioning, segmentation, buyer insights, and launches into discovery guides, talk tracks, objection handling, competitive battlecards, and customer-facing narratives. Reinforce consistent, accurate messaging across the customer journey.
* Build practical programs around prospecting, discovery, qualification, business-case development, stakeholder engagement, and competitive selling. Use call recordings and deal insights to identify gaps, share effective approaches, and equip managers to reinforce skills in their regular coaching.
* Partner with Customer Success to develop value-review, renewal, and cross-sell playbooks that connect customer needs to relevant capabilities and measurable outcomes. Strengthen Sales-to-CS handoffs and continuity of the customer story.
* Develop reusable prompts, templates, and lightweight automations for account research, meeting preparation, content adaptation, and coaching. Partner with Revenue Operations on integrations and data workflows, with clear human-review steps and safeguards for sensitive information and output quality.
* Organize and maintain accessible enablement resources with clear ownership, review cycles, and version control. Work with content owners to keep materials current and retire outdated guidance.
* Facilitate engaging workshops, launch-readiness sessions, and sales kickoff programming. Build communications and follow-through that help new skills, tools, and processes become daily habits.
* Partner with GTM leaders to design the operating mechanisms that reinforce new behaviors after kickoffs, launches, and training programs. Build the meeting cadences, pipeline and deal reviews, one-on-one coaching guides, and scorecards that shape how our leaders communicate, coach, and measure, and run 30/60/90-day reinforcement plans that track whether the new behaviors show up in the field.
* Establish baselines and success measures with Revenue Operations and GTM leaders. Track readiness, adoption, and demonstrated proficiency alongside ramp time, conversion, deal progression, and customer growth outcomes; use findings to refine the roadmap.
* Other duties as assigned by management.

**Required Education and Experience**

* 6+ years of relevant experience in B2B sales, revenue enablement, customer success enablement, or GTM operations, including at least 3 years directly designing and delivering enablement programs.
* Demonstrated, sophisticated use of AI (think building workflows, skills, plugins etc. vs. just prompt-and-answer) to improve enablement or GTM work, with sound judgment about accuracy, privacy, and where human review is essential.
* A track record of building or scaling onboarding, product enablement, and ongoing skills programs with measurable impact on performance.
* Experience with technical B2B products, ideally cybersecurity, and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear business value for different audiences.
* Strong facilitation and coaching skills: you’re equally comfortable leading a workshop, giving constructive feedback, and partnering with senior leaders.
* Experience partnering with sales and customer success leaders to build manager coaching cadences and reinforcement plans that sustain behavior change after a kickoff or launch.
* Practical understanding of consultative selling, qualification, and the customer lifecycle, from prospecting and discovery to renewal and expansion.
* Hands-on experience using CRM, conversation intelligence, and knowledge or learning platforms to diagnose needs, deliver programs, and assess results.
* Strong writing, project management, and cross-functional collaboration skills. You can prioritize a focused roadmap while personally creating materials and delivering training.

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* Experience serving banks, credit unions, or other regulated industries;

**About MiLa**

**MìLà is a Chinese food company**. Our teams work tirelessly to enhance delicious products that we all enjoy at home! While MìLà is a Chinese food brand, it’s really a celebration of the power of food to bring us together, share our stories, and discover new flavors and cultures.

new_jobs.title: K-8 After-School Program Coordinator (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with youth and being part of a diverse, supportive, and talented community? Are you passionate about youth program development and are a natural leader? If so, please consider joining our team at Tessellations. We are currently accepting applications for a part-time K-8 After-School Program Coordinator starting immediately. Full-time summer Camp employment opportunities are available following the school year. Competitive salary available.

Tessellations is a modern, innovative Preschool-8th non-profit school for gifted learners based in Cupertino, CA. Our mission is to provide challenging experiential education that recognizes and nurtures the individual strengths of gifted learners, empowering them to confidently express who they are and pursue a meaningful life.

At Tessellations, community is a core value. A strong community was instrumental in launching our school during the pandemic and has facilitated our strong growth and success since then. Our team consists of passionate, qualified, and dedicated staff from diverse backgrounds and includes a nationally renowned gifted expert. We believe that it is time to open a new chapter in 21st-century gifted education by forging a model that fosters a cultural ecosystem within the school that promotes innovative thinking and intellectual risk-taking. Moving on from an antiquated model born during the Industrial Revolution, we favor transferable skills over compliance and rote memorization, and collaboration over competition. We believe that assessments should function as guidance for the depth and complexity of learning rather than for judgment or sorting.

**About Our After-School Program**

Our after-school program, Base Camp, provides program options for our wonderful TK - 8th grade students following the school day. We currently operate three programs, TK-Base Camp, Odyssey, and Clubs, until 6:00 pm Monday - Thursday and until 5:00 pm on Fridays. Our Odyssey and Club programs are open to K-8. Students participating in Odyssey are able to reset from a full day of instruction by engaging in self-directed indoor/outdoor play with peers, relaxing in the Oasis Room, completing homework, and or engaging in a teacher-led activity. Our enrichment Clubs are offered seasonally with offerings in the subject categories of social studies, sports and movement, world languages, arts and crafts, and STEM. Clubs typically meet once a week for 60 minutes to 120 minutes and are led by Base Camp Teachers, Tessellations Faculty, and local enrichment program vendors.

By working at Tessellations, you will work with students who love to learn, engaged parents/guardians who are grateful for your work, and supportive colleagues who will help bring out your personal best.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Work Schedule: Mon-Thu: 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM; Fri 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM
* Design and implement age-appropriate educational, creative, and physical enrichment activities tailored to K-8 students for our day camps.
* Create and foster a safe and nurturing learning environment where all students feel seen, heard, and included.
* Co-develop and facilitate engaging, student-centered enrichment activities spanning arts, STEM, and recreation that nurture elementary curiosity while encouraging middle school autonomy.
* Maintain an active and visible leadership presence within the department during operational hours, empowering staff and decisively addressing real-time operational needs in the Director's absence.
* Serve as the heart of our program’s connection with families, making sure parents/guardians feel well-informed, deeply supported, and actively invited into their child’s after-school journey.
* Support student self-regulation by implementing restorative methods, early de-escalation strategies, and growth-mindset praise that recognizes hard work and dedication.
* Facilitate restorative conflict resolution between peers, helping students identify feelings and communicate needs.
* Work with the other Base Camp staff to supervise the students during indoor and outdoor play, snack time, and transition periods.
* Track daily student attendance and follow secure student check-in/check-out procedures with authorized parents/guardians/caregivers.
* Maintain a safe and organized environment, supervising students closely at all times.
* Serve as a versatile team member by filling in for absent staff on short notice, seamlessly adapting to different roles and shifts to maintain continuous, high-quality operations.
* Support the Program Director with the coordination and facilitation of our academic competitions.
* Attend staff meetings and actively engage with professional development opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum of 2 years of elementary and middle school experience, preferably in an after-school or summer camp program setting.
* Minimum of 1 year working with transitional kindergarten, preschool, or kindergarten-aged children (experience in after-school or summer camp settings).
* Ability to actively observe, read, and accurately interpret youth’s verbal and non-verbal cues to meet their emotional and developmental needs in real-time.
* A genuine commitment to inclusive practices that welcome and celebrate families from all backgrounds.
* Strong verbal communication skills
* Passing a criminal background check upon job offer.
* Current CPR and First Aid certifications (or willingness to obtain upon hire).

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Social-emotional teaching experience
* Experience teaching gifted learners

* Connection to nature
