**Call Center Manager**
-----------------------

**Omari Construction Group – Remote**  
**Job Type:** Full-Time Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** $50,000–$60,000 annually + bonuses

**About Us**
------------

Omari Construction is a growing construction company specializing in commercial construction, luxury residential design-build, and exterior remodeling and insurance restoration. We are committed to delivering exceptional service, operational excellence, and results across every division.

At Omari, we value **integrity, innovation, and performance**. We are seeking motivated professionals who take ownership, lead with accountability, and thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

**About the Position**
----------------------

We are seeking an experienced, highly organized, and results-driven **Call Center Manager** to build, lead, and optimize our outbound call center operations.

This individual will be responsible for managing call center representatives, developing effective lead-generation strategies, overseeing appointment scheduling, maintaining accurate CRM records, and driving measurable performance.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with strong call center management experience, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to develop scalable processes that support company growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Call Center Leadership & Operations**

* Build, manage, and continuously improve daily call center operations.
* Recruit, onboard, train, and coach call center representatives.
* Establish daily calling priorities, performance expectations, and accountability measures.
* Conduct regular team meetings, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions.
* Develop call scripts, training materials, and standardized operating procedures.
* Ensure consistent call center coverage and efficient appointment scheduling.

**Lead Generation & Appointment Management**

* Oversee outbound calling campaigns to generate qualified appointments for insurance inspections and retail home improvement estimates.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage quality lead sources and calling lists.
* Monitor lead quality, appointment conversion rates, and follow-up activity.
* Coordinate with sales leadership to ensure appointments are properly scheduled, tracked, and completed.
* Maintain accurate lead records, call dispositions, and appointment outcomes.
* Optimize calling strategies to improve contact rates and appointment performance.

**Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Monitor daily call volume, representative productivity, appointment conversion rates, and no-show rates.
* Review daily and weekly call center performance reports.
* Maintain individual representative scorecards and identify coaching opportunities.
* Provide weekly performance updates to company leadership.
* Develop automated reporting tools and dashboards to track department performance.

**Systems Management & Process Improvement**

* Oversee the administration and optimization of RingCentral, RingCX, and related communication systems.
* Maintain accurate customer and appointment records within AccuLynx CRM.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows through automation, AI tools, and system integrations.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive Call Center Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure calling lists, CRM records, and reporting systems remain accurate and organized.
* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and operations teams to improve efficiency and customer experience.

**Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Monitor call quality, representative performance, and adherence to company standards.
* Ensure compliance with applicable telemarketing regulations, including Do Not Call requirements.
* Review call outcomes, lead classifications, and appointment records for accuracy.
* Identify operational issues and implement corrective action.
* Maintain a high standard of professionalism and customer communication.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5+ years of experience in call center operations, outbound sales, telemarketing, or appointment setting.
* 2+ years of experience managing or supervising a call center team.
* Demonstrated success improving call center productivity, appointment conversion, and team performance.
* Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development skills.
* Experience managing outbound calling campaigns and lead-generation strategies.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms, call center software, and performance reporting tools.
* Experience with RingCentral, RingCX, AccuLynx, or similar platforms preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet performance objectives.
* Experience in construction, home improvement, roofing, or insurance restoration is a plus.

**Performance Expectations**
----------------------------

Success in this position will be measured by the ability to develop a productive, efficient, and scalable call center operation.

Key performance objectives include:

* Supporting representative productivity targets of approximately **200–300 outbound dials per day**.
* Driving an average of **2–4 qualified appointments per representative per day**.
* Maintaining accurate CRM records and complete call dispositions.
* Improving appointment completion rates and minimizing no-shows.
* Delivering consistent, accurate weekly reporting.
* Developing documented processes that support long-term operational growth.

**Compensation & Performance Bonus**
------------------------------------

**Base Compensation: $50,000–$60,000 annually**, based on experience and qualifications.

In addition to base compensation, this position offers the opportunity to earn **up to $30,000 in annual performance-based bonuses**, subject to the terms of the applicable compensation agreement.

Customer Success

**About Delinea:**  
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. **Freight Support Manager**

**Company:** Transportli  
**Website:** transportli.com  
**Industry:** Transportation Technology & Logistics  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Location:** Remote

**About Transportli**

Transportli is an online shipping marketplace connecting individuals and businesses with transportation providers across the United States.

Our platform helps customers compare shipping quotes, communicate with carriers, and arrange transportation services, including Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) freight, expedited shipping, and auto transport.

We’re building a simpler, more transparent shipping experience through technology, competitive pricing, and reliable customer support.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused **Freight Support Manager** to oversee customer support operations and help ensure a smooth shipping experience for customers and transportation providers using the Transportli marketplace.

The ideal candidate has experience in freight transportation, strong communication skills, and the ability to resolve shipping-related issues efficiently.

This role involves assisting customers with shipping requests, coordinating communication between marketplace participants, monitoring shipment progress, and improving customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Support & Freight Assistance**

* Respond to customer inquiries via email, live chat, and phone.
* Assist customers with shipping requests, quotes, and booking procedures.
* Explain freight transportation options, transit times, and service requirements.
* Help customers understand LTL freight classifications, packaging requirements, and accessorial charges.
* Resolve customer concerns related to pickups, deliveries, and shipment updates.

**Carrier Communication**

* Communicate with transportation providers regarding shipment availability and service details.
* Facilitate communication between customers and carriers.
* Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
* Monitor shipment progress and provide timely updates.
* Escalate service disruptions, delays, and transportation-related issues.

**Shipment Support & Documentation**

* Review shipment information for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist customers with Bills of Lading (BOLs), Proofs of Delivery (PODs), and shipping documentation.
* Support customers with freight damage reports, billing discrepancies, and service complaints.
* Maintain accurate shipment records and customer communication histories.

**Marketplace Operations**

* Monitor incoming shipping requests and customer inquiries.
* Follow up with customers who have received quotes but have not completed bookings.
* Identify opportunities to improve quote acceptance and booking conversion rates.
* Help transportation providers navigate the Transportli platform.
* Collaborate with the product and operations teams to improve marketplace functionality.

**Performance & Quality Management**

* Maintain high customer satisfaction and response-time standards.
* Track support performance, recurring issues, and customer feedback.
* Develop and improve customer support procedures.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.
* Prepare periodic reports on support activities and performance.

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in freight transportation, logistics operations, or customer support.
* Understanding of U.S. freight transportation, particularly LTL and expedited shipping.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with CRM systems, transportation management systems, or customer support software.
* Ability to handle multiple customer requests and prioritize urgent issues.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with U.S. freight carriers and transportation marketplaces.
* Knowledge of LTL freight classes, NMFC classifications, and accessorial charges.
* Experience in auto transport or expedited freight operations.
* Familiarity with freight claims and shipping documentation.
* Experience improving customer conversion rates and retention.
* Previous experience with digital marketplaces or logistics technology platforms.

**What We Offer**

* Remote work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a growing transportation technology platform.
* Collaborative and supportive team.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* Direct involvement in improving customer experience and marketplace operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* **First Response Time:** Speed of responding to customer inquiries.
* **Customer Satisfaction (CSAT):** Quality of customer support interactions.
* **Quote-to-Booking Conversion:** Percentage of shipping requests converted into bookings.
* **Issue Resolution Time:** Efficiency in resolving customer and shipment-related issues.
* **Shipment Support Quality:** Accuracy of shipment information and timely communication.
* **Customer Retention:** Percentage of customers returning to use the platform.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their resume and a brief introduction highlighting their experience in U.S. freight transportation and customer support.

**Join Transportli and help us make freight shipping simpler, more transparent, and accessible to everyone.**

**About Rhythm Energy**
-----------------------

Rhythm is a renewable energy and technology company on a mission to make clean energy simple, accessible, and affordable for everyone.

We combine deep energy market expertise with technology, design, and data science to deliver innovative, transparent, and customer-centric energy solutions. From helping customers take control of their electricity choices to developing new products and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future, we're rethinking how people interact with energy.

We're a fast-growing, mission-driven team that values ownership, collaboration, and innovation. We move quickly, challenge conventional thinking, and empower our people to solve meaningful problems and make a real impact.

At Rhythm, you'll have the opportunity to help shape the future of energy while building products, systems, and experiences that make a difference for our customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring an **Operations Analyst** to help manage and improve the systems and workflows that connect Rhythm with our utilities, vendors, and external partners.

You'll take ownership of critical operational processes, including transaction exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests. Working across internal teams and external partners, you'll investigate issues, resolve exceptions, and ensure our operations run accurately and efficiently.

This role goes beyond day-to-day execution. You'll analyze operational data, identify recurring issues, and help implement improvements that enable Rhythm to grow and scale.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to build a career in operations within a fast-growing energy company.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and manage operational workflows, including account exceptions, failed orders, and customer-initiated requests.
* Work with our Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) vendor, utilities, and internal teams to investigate and resolve transaction exceptions.
* Analyze operational data to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities for improvement.
* Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.
* Communicate system bugs, operational risks, and business feedback to internal stakeholders and department leadership.
* Support operational requests within established service-level agreements (SLAs), ensuring timely and accurate resolution.
* Partner with your manager and cross-functional teams to execute prioritized initiatives and meet deadlines.
* Document workflows, processes, and resolutions to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 1+ year of experience in backend operations, transaction management, operational workflows, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.
* Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Excel and comfort working with operational data and reporting tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to collaborate across internal teams and external partners.
* Ability to learn new systems, processes, and technologies quickly.
* A proactive, self-motivated approach and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* A collaborative mindset, openness to feedback, and a genuine interest in continuous improvement.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in retail energy, electricity supply, utilities, or another transaction-intensive industry.
* Familiarity with Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) systems and transaction management.
* Experience with customer service ticketing platforms, EDI management software, or data visualization tools.
* Experience testing operational workflows and documenting business processes.
* Interest in renewable energy, sustainability, and energy innovation.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Operational workflows and transaction exceptions are managed accurately and within established SLAs.
* Failed orders and account exceptions are investigated and resolved with minimal disruption to customers and internal teams.
* Recurring operational issues are identified through data analysis and translated into actionable improvements.
* Processes become more efficient, reliable, and scalable as Rhythm grows.
* Internal teams and external partners receive clear, timely communication on issues and resolutions.
* You independently manage your responsibilities and become a trusted contributor to the Operations team.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**
--------------------------------

* **Meaningful ownership.** Manage critical processes that directly impact Rhythm's customers and business operations.
* **Career growth.** Build your expertise in operations, energy markets, systems integration, and process improvement.
* **Analytical challenges.** Investigate complex issues, work with operational data, and turn insights into improvements.
* **Cross-functional exposure.** Collaborate with internal teams, utilities, vendors, and external partners.
* **Remote flexibility.** Work remotely within the United States while contributing to a collaborative team.
* **Our culture.** We're friendly, transparent, and value curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning.
* **Make a difference.** Help build a more efficient, technology-driven energy company focused on a sustainable future.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Clinical Training Support Specialist plays a vital supportive role in designing and managing high-quality onboarding and clinical training across the entire Included Health Clinical Practice/Clinical Org practice—spanning Virtual Care, Population Health, and emerging service lines. Your primary focus will be on instructional design, transforming complex clinical policies and workflows into engaging digital learning content (eLearning modules, video simulations, and interactive scenarios). As a core pillar of the training team, you will manage our Learning Management System (LMS), collect and analyze training data, and act as a dedicated learner assistant to ensure seamless educational rollouts.

While your primary focus is content creation and support, you will also assist in cross-covering live training sessions for various onboarding cohorts. You will be an AI-forward builder who uses AI tools and other technologies to accelerate content development, reduce manual work, and embed just-in-time support into the clinician experience. This role is ideal for an instructional design professional who excels at behind-the-scenes content creation and LMS administration, yet remains flexible enough to step into the room to support live learners and educators when needed.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Content Creation, Execution & Maintenance**

* Prepare, use, and update existing training materials (slides, facilitator guides, job aids, scenarios, and exercises) created and/or approved by the Senior Clinical Training Specialists, Manager, and CKE team.
* Surface content gaps or inconsistencies you see during training (e.g., slide doesn’t match CRC, workflow screenshot is outdated) so they can be prioritized for formal updates.
* Use LMS and training tools at a proficient user level (launching sessions, tracking completions, pulling basic reports).
* Design instruction based on clinical workflows in collaboration with CKE team and stakeholders.

**2. Cross-Service Line Clinical Facilitation**

* Deliver live virtual training (group sessions, small-group breakouts, and 1:1 coaching) for clinical new hires and tenured clinicians across Virtual Care and Population Health service lines.
* Facilitate a mix of foundational, workflow, and application-based sessions (e.g., documentation practice, care plan workflows, triage scenarios, navigation workflows) using adult learning best practices.
* Support or co-lead clinical simulations, mock calls, and role plays, observing performance, giving clear, behavior-based feedback, and escalating clinical safety concerns appropriately.
* Flex into different service lines as hiring volume, redesign work, or audit findings shift the training portfolio — maintaining sufficient cross-training to be safe and effective wherever you are deployed.

**3. Cohort Support & Learner Coaching**

* Partner with the Senior Clinical Training Specialists to execute the day-to-day plan for new hire cohorts (agenda, timing, logistics, handoff points).
* Monitor learner engagement, participation, and performance during sessions; identify individuals who need additional support and provide targeted coaching or remediation as directed by the Senior(s) and Manager.
* Use rubrics, checklists, and competency tools to document learner progress and escalate concerns regarding readiness for independent work.
* Contribute to a psychologically safe learning environment where clinicians can practice, make mistakes, and receive direct but supportive feedback.

**4. Data, Feedback, and Continuous Improvement**

* Capture and share learner feedback, questions, and pain points from the classroom in a structured way to inform curriculum improvements and service-line decisions.
* Create and monitor formal metrics for learning and successful application of skills.
* Use available data (e.g., knowledge checks, simulation scores, survey results) to describe trends you’re seeing in learner performance and experience, and to validate where additional coaching or clarification is needed.
* Participate in course audits, pilots, and retrospectives, giving concrete recommendations on pacing, activities, and scaffolding from the trainer perspective.
* Champion a “Spirit of Inquiry” by modeling curiosity, evidence-based practice, and openness to feedback in your own facilitation.

**5. Surge Support & Operational Flex**

* During surge periods or large cohorts, act as co-facilitator/producer, managing breakout rooms, chat questions, tech issues, and basic operational workflows so Senior Trainers can focus on high-complexity clinical teaching and stakeholder interactions.
* Lead or co-lead baseline operational sessions (e.g., navigation of training environments, structured documentation practice, non-clinical workflows) when appropriate to free up Senior bandwidth.
* Adhere to and reinforce capacity rules and surge protocols defined by the Manager and Senior Trainers (e.g., ratio rules, blackout dates, backup facilitator coverage).

**Required Qualifications:**

Experience:

* 2+ years of experience in formal clinical/healthcare training, precepting, clinical education, or adult learning.
* Specifically, instructional design, LMS management, data collection, learner assistance, etc.

Facilitation & communication:

* Strong virtual facilitation skills (Zoom/Google Meet or similar).
* Demonstrated ability to explain complex clinical workflows in clear, practical language and to give direct, respectful feedback to peers or learners.

Collaboration & adaptability:

* Comfortable flexing between service lines, cohorts, and workstreams as priorities change.
* Proven ability to build trust with clinicians, people leaders, and cross-functional partners.

* Clinical credentials: RN/BSN or other equivalent clinical degree with an active, unrestricted license (or able to reactivate an expired license, if applicable).
* Experience in one or more of Included Health’s core c
